decisions.choice: "मुझे अपनी पीठ के पीछे फेंक दिया" (L, B); "मुझसे मुँह मोड़ लिया और मुझे ठुकरा दिया" (R)
decisions.reason: Rejection with contempt (meaning m3); Literal and Balanced keep the picture, Readable says it with a Hindi idiom, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "бросил за свою спину" (L, B); "отвернулся от Меня и отбросил Меня в сторону" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the image of contempt (m3); Readable spells it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: massekhot "鋳物の像" (L, B), "金属を溶かして作った偶像" (R)
decisions.reason: As NUM 33:52 (cast images).

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא רָעָה֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י לְיָֽרָבְעָם֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֔יר עָצ֥וּר וְעָז֖וּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבִֽעַרְתִּי֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית־יָרָבְעָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְבַעֵ֥ר הַגָּלָ֖ל עַד־תֻּמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore behold I [am] bringing evil to [the] house of Jeroboam, and I will cut off from Jeroboam one urinating against a wall, restrained and left free in Israel; and I will burn up after [the] house of Jeroboam just as one burns up the dung until its finishing.

en.L: therefore, look, I [am] bringing evil on the house of Jeroboam, and I will cut off from Jeroboam [every] one who urinates against a wall, bond and free, in Israel, and I will burn up after the house of Jeroboam as one burns up the dung, until it is finished.
en.B: Therefore I am about to bring disaster on Jeroboam's house. From Jeroboam I will cut off every male in Israel, bond or free. I will burn away what remains of his house, the way someone burns up dung until none is left.
en.R: So I am going to bring disaster on Jeroboam's family. I will destroy every man and boy in Jeroboam's family in Israel, slave or free. I will get rid of his family completely, the way a person burns up dung until nothing is left.

es.L: por tanto, he aquí que yo traigo el mal sobre la casa de Jeroboam, y cortaré de Jeroboam a [todo] el que orina contra la pared, siervo y libre, en Israel; y quemaré lo que quede de la casa de Jeroboam como se quema el estiércol, hasta que se acabe.
es.B: Por eso, voy a traer desgracia sobre la casa de Jeroboam. Exterminaré de Jeroboam a todo varón en Israel, sea esclavo o libre. Quemaré lo que quede de su casa, como quien quema estiércol hasta que no queda nada.
es.R: Por eso voy a traer desgracia sobre la familia de Jeroboam. Destruiré a todos los hombres y niños de la familia de Jeroboam en Israel, sean esclavos o libres. Acabaré por completo con su familia, como una persona quema estiércol hasta que no queda nada.

fr.L: c’est pourquoi, voici, je vais faire venir le malheur sur la maison de Jéroboam, et je retrancherai de Jéroboam quiconque urine contre un mur, esclave ou libre en Israël, et je balaierai par le feu la maison de Jéroboam, comme on brûle le fumier jusqu’à ce qu’il soit consumé.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi je vais faire venir le malheur sur la maison de Jéroboam. Je retrancherai de Jéroboam tout homme en Israël, esclave ou libre. Je brûlerai ce qui reste de sa maison, comme on brûle le fumier jusqu’à ce qu’il n’en reste rien.
fr.R: C’est pourquoi je vais faire venir le malheur sur la famille de Jéroboam. Je ferai disparaître tous les hommes et tous les garçons de sa famille en Israël, esclaves ou libres. Je me débarrasserai complètement de sa famille, comme on brûle du fumier jusqu’à ce qu’il n’en reste rien.

sw.L: kwa hiyo, tazama, mimi [ninaleta] maovu juu ya nyumba ya Yeroboamu, nami nitamkatilia mbali Yeroboamu kila akojoaye ukutani, aliyefungwa na aliyeachwa huru katika Israeli; nami nitaiteketeza nyumba ya Yeroboamu kama mtu ateketezavyo mavi, mpaka yamekwisha.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nitaleta maafa juu ya nyumba ya Yeroboamu. Nitamkatilia mbali Yeroboamu kila mwanamume katika Israeli, mtumwa au huru. Nitayateketeza mabaki ya nyumba yake, kama mtu ateketezavyo mavi mpaka yasibaki.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitaleta maafa juu ya jamaa ya Yeroboamu. Nitamwangamiza kila mwanamume na kila mvulana katika jamaa ya Yeroboamu katika Israeli, mtumwa au huru. Nitaiondoa jamaa yake kabisa, kama mtu anavyoteketeza mavi mpaka yasibaki kitu.

vi.L: cho nên, kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp giáng tai họa trên nhà Giê-rô-bô-am; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt khỏi Giê-rô-bô-am [mọi] kẻ đái vào tường, kẻ bị giam cũng như kẻ được tự do trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quét sạch nhà Giê-rô-bô-am như người ta đốt phân cho đến khi hết sạch.
vi.B: Vì thế, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp giáng tai họa trên nhà Giê-rô-bô-am. Ta sẽ diệt khỏi Giê-rô-bô-am mọi người nam trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù nô lệ hay tự do. Ta sẽ đốt sạch những gì còn lại của nhà ấy, như người ta đốt phân cho đến khi không còn gì.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp giáng tai họa trên gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am. Ta sẽ tiêu diệt mọi người nam trong gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am tại Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù là nô lệ hay người tự do. Ta sẽ diệt sạch gia đình ấy, như người ta đốt phân cho đến khi không còn gì.

ko.L: 그러므로 보아라, 내가 여로보암의 집에 재앙을 내려, 여로보암에게서 벽에 소변을 보는 자를, 이스라엘에서 매인 자나 놓인 자나 [모두] 끊어 버리겠다. 그리고 사람이 똥을 다 없어질 때까지 태워 버리듯이, 여로보암의 집을 쓸어 태워 버리겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 여로보암의 집안에 재앙을 내리겠다. 이스라엘에서 여로보암에게 속한 남자는 종이든 자유인이든 모두 끊어 버리겠다. 사람이 똥을 남김없이 태워 버리듯이, 여로보암 집안의 남은 자들을 쓸어 버리겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 여로보암의 집안에 재앙을 내리겠다. 이스라엘에 있는 여로보암 집안의 남자는 어른이든 아이든, 종이든 자유인이든 모두 없애 버리겠다. 사람이 똥을 남김없이 태워 버리듯이 그의 집안을 완전히 없애 버리겠다.

pt.L: portanto, eis que eu [estou] trazendo o mal sobre a casa de Jeroboão, e eliminarei de Jeroboão [todo] o que urina na parede, o preso e o livre em Israel, e queimarei o que restar da casa de Jeroboão como se queima o esterco, até que acabe.
pt.B: Por isso vou trazer a desgraça sobre a casa de Jeroboão. Eliminarei de Jeroboão todo homem em Israel, seja escravo, seja livre. Varrerei o que restar da casa dele, como quem queima esterco até não sobrar nada.
pt.R: Por isso vou trazer desgraça sobre a família de Jeroboão. Vou destruir todos os homens e meninos da família de Jeroboão em Israel, escravos ou livres. Vou acabar com a família dele de uma vez, como quem queima esterco até não sobrar nada.

am.L: ስለዚህ እነሆ፣ በኢዮርብዓም ቤት ላይ ክፉ አመጣለሁ፤ ከኢዮርብዓምም በእስራኤል ያለውን ግድግዳ ላይ የሚሸናውን [ሁሉ]፣ የታሰረውንም የተለቀቀውንም አጠፋለሁ፤ ሰው ፋንድያን ፈጽሞ እስኪጠፋ ድረስ እንደሚያቃጥል የኢዮርብዓምን ቤት ተከትዬ አቃጥላለሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ በኢዮርብዓም ቤት ላይ ጥፋት አመጣለሁ። ከኢዮርብዓም ወገን በእስራኤል ያለውን ወንድ ሁሉ፣ ባሪያውንም ነጻውንም አጠፋለሁ። ሰው ፋንድያን አንድም ሳይቀር እንደሚያቃጥል የኢዮርብዓምን ቤት ቅሬታ አቃጥላለሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ በኢዮርብዓም ቤተሰብ ላይ ጥፋት አመጣለሁ። በእስራኤል ካለው ከኢዮርብዓም ቤተሰብ ወንዱንና ወንድ ልጁን ሁሉ፣ ባሪያም ይሁን ነጻ፣ አጠፋለሁ። ሰው ፋንድያን ምንም ሳይቀር እንደሚያቃጥል ቤተሰቡን ፈጽሜ አስወግዳለሁ።

hi.L: इसलिए देखो, मैं यारोबाम के घराने पर विपत्ति ला रहा हूँ, और यारोबाम के [हर] दीवार पर मूतनेवाले को, क्या बँधुआ क्या स्वतंत्र, इस्राएल में से काट डालूँगा, और यारोबाम के घराने को ऐसे जला डालूँगा जैसे कोई गोबर को तब तक जलाता है जब तक वह मिट न जाए।
hi.B: इसलिए मैं यारोबाम के घराने पर विपत्ति लाने पर हूँ। मैं इस्राएल में यारोबाम के हर पुरुष को, चाहे दास हो या स्वतंत्र, काट डालूँगा। मैं उसके घराने के बचे हुओं को ऐसे जला डालूँगा जैसे कोई गोबर को तब तक जलाता है जब तक कुछ न बचे।
hi.R: इसलिए मैं यारोबाम के परिवार पर विपत्ति लानेवाला हूँ। इस्राएल में यारोबाम के परिवार के हर पुरुष और लड़के को, चाहे दास हो या स्वतंत्र, मैं नाश कर दूँगा। मैं उसके परिवार को पूरी तरह मिटा दूँगा, जैसे कोई गोबर को जलाता है जब तक कुछ भी न बचे।

ru.L: поэтому вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навожу зло на дом Иеровоама и истреблю у Иеровоама мочащегося к стене, связанного и свободного в Израиле, и выжгу [всё] за домом Иеровоама, как выжигают навоз, до конца.
ru.B: Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу беду на дом Иеровоама. Я истреблю у Иеровоама всякого мужчину в Израиле, и раба, и свободного. Я выжгу остатки его дома, как сжигают навоз, пока от него ничего не останется.
ru.R: Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу беду на семью Иеровоама. Я уничтожу в Израиле всех мужчин и мальчиков из семьи Иеровоама — и рабов, и свободных. Я совсем избавлюсь от его семьи, как сжигают навоз, пока от него ничего не останется.

ja.L: それゆえ、見なさい、わたしはヤロブアムの家に災いをもたらす。わたしはヤロブアムから、壁に向かって小便をする者を、イスラエルにいる、つながれた者も解き放たれた者も断ち、人が糞を燃やし尽くすように、ヤロブアムの家の後を、それが尽きるまで燃やし尽くす。
ja.B: それゆえ、わたしはヤロブアムの家に災いを下す。わたしはイスラエルにいるヤロブアムの男子を、つながれた者も自由な者も、ことごとく断つ。人が糞を燃やして跡形もなくするように、ヤロブアムの家の残りの者を焼き払う。
ja.R: だから、わたしはヤロブアムの一族に災いを下す。イスラエルにいるヤロブアムの一族の男の人も男の子も、奴隷も自由な人も、一人残らず滅ぼす。人がふんを焼いて何も残らないようにするように、わたしはヤロブアムの一族をすっかり取り除く。

uk.L: тому ось Я наводжу лихо на дім Єровоама, і винищу в Єровоама [кожного], хто мочиться на стіну, невільного й вільного в Ізраїлі, і вимету дім Єровоама, як вимітають гній, аж доки його не стане.
uk.B: Тому Я ось-ось наведу лихо на Єровоамів дім. Я винищу в Єровоама кожного чоловіка в Ізраїлі, невільного й вільного. Я спалю те, що залишиться від його дому, як спалюють гній, аж доки нічого не лишиться.
uk.R: Тож Я наведу лихо на Єровоамову родину. Я знищу в Ізраїлі кожного чоловіка і хлопця з Єровоамової родини, раба чи вільного. Я позбудуся його родини цілком, так як людина спалює гній, аж доки нічого не лишиться.

decisions.choice: one who urinates against a wall: a male
decisions.reason: This coarse phrase means a male, from the boy upward, and is used in threats to wipe out every male of a household (1 Samuel 25:22, 34; 1 Kings 16:11; 21:21; 2 Kings 9:8). The coarse words also show contempt.

decisions.choice: restrained and left free: everyone, whatever his standing
decisions.reason: The pair of words is a fixed expression for "everyone" (Deuteronomy 32:36; 1 Kings 21:21; 2 Kings 9:8; 14:26), but what each half means is not certain. It may mean slave and free, someone kept at home and someone free to go out, a minor and an adult, or someone under protection and someone left on his own. Whichever it is, the pair covers every male without exception.

decisions.choice: I will burn up after the house of Jeroboam as one burns up the dung: a complete and contemptuous removal
alternatives: I will sweep away the house of Jeroboam as one sweeps away dung
decisions.reason: The verb means to burn, and also to sweep away or purge (Deuteronomy 13:6). "After" means what remains behind. The picture is either of dried dung burned as fuel until none is left, or of filth cleared away until the place is clean. Either way, the house of Jeroboam is treated as refuse and removed completely.

decisions.choice: every male (Balanced); every man and boy (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the plain sense of the coarse idiom (m1), as 1 Samuel 25:22 does; Literal keeps its picture. No gender setting is used, because only males are meant.

decisions.choice: bond and free (Literal); bond or free (Balanced); slave or free (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the pair as a fixed expression close to its literal sense; Readable uses the most likely meaning (m2). All mean every male without exception, and the footnote gives the other possible senses. The same wording is used at 21:21.

decisions.choice: disaster (Balanced, Readable); evil (Literal)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means evil done or evil suffered. Here it is the harm Yahweh brings as punishment, not wrongdoing.

decisions.choice: "el que orina contra la pared" (L); "todo varón" (B); "todos los hombres y niños" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the coarse Hebrew expression for a male; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tout homme" (B); "tous les hommes et tous les garçons" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the plain sense of the coarse idiom, as the English does; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: kila mwanamume (Balanced); kila mwanamume na kila mvulana (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's coarse "kila akojoaye ukutani"; Balanced and Readable give its sense, every male, as the English does.

decisions.choice: maafa
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "maovu" (evil); Balanced and Readable say "maafa" (disaster), the harm God brings, not wrongdoing.

decisions.choice: "kẻ đái vào tường" (L); "mọi người nam" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the coarse Hebrew picture for a male, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "벽에 소변을 보는 자" (L), "남자" (B), "남자는 어른이든 아이든" (R)
alternatives: the Literal wording at every level
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the coarse Hebrew expression; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "재앙" at Literal as well
decisions.reason: "악을 내리다" is not natural Korean; "재앙" is the ordinary word for harm sent as judgment, and the meaning is unchanged.

decisions.choice: o que urina na parede (L); todo homem (B); todos os homens e meninos (R); o preso e o livre (L), escravo ... livre (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 16:11; 21:21): Literal keeps the coarse picture, as 1 Samuel 25:22 has it in Portuguese; Balanced and Readable give its sense (m1), with no gender setting, since only males are meant. The fixed pair (m2) is "o preso e o livre" at Literal, close to the Hebrew words, and "escravo ou livre" at Balanced and Readable, its most likely sense.

decisions.choice: queimarei (L); varrerei (B)
decisions.reason: The verb means to burn and also to purge (m3). Literal keeps "queimar"; Balanced says "varrer", which holds the sense of clearing away while the comparison with burning dung keeps the fire.

decisions.choice: "ግድግዳ ላይ የሚሸናውን" (who urinates against a wall)
decisions.reason: As the Amharic 1 Samuel 25:22 and 34 at Literal; Balanced says "ወንድ ሁሉ" (every male), Readable "ወንዱንና ወንድ ልጁን ሁሉ", the same wording each time the phrase returns (16:11; 21:21).

decisions.choice: "የታሰረውንም የተለቀቀውንም" (Literal); "ባሪያውንም ነጻውንም" (Balanced); "ባሪያም ይሁን ነጻ" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew pair (restrained and let go); the other levels give its sense, everyone of whatever standing.

decisions.choice: "दीवार पर मूतनेवाले" (L); "हर पुरुष" (B); "हर पुरुष और लड़के" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew's coarse expression for a male (meaning m1); Literal keeps it, as the English does, and Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "क्या बँधुआ क्या स्वतंत्र" (L); "चाहे दास हो या स्वतंत्र" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Restrained and left free means everyone, whatever his standing (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: "विपत्ति"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the one for evil; here it is the disaster Yahweh brings on the house, so Hindi says "विपत्ति" at every level, where the English Literal keeps "evil".

decisions.choice: "мочащегося к стене" (L); "всякого мужчину" (B); "всех мужчин и мальчиков" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the coarse Hebrew idiom for a male (m1); the other levels say what is meant, as the English does. The same idiom recurs in 16:11.

decisions.choice: "связанного и свободного" (L); "и раба, и свободного" (B); "и рабов, и свободных" (R)
decisions.reason: Everyone, whatever his standing (m2).

decisions.choice: "зло" (L); "беду" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew word, the other levels say disaster.

decisions.choice: mashtin beqir "壁に向かって小便をする者" (L), "男子" (B), "男の人も男の子も" (R)
decisions.reason: The crude idiom means every male; Literal keeps it, Balanced and Readable give the sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'atsur ve'azuv "つながれた者も解き放たれた者も" (L), "つながれた者も自由な者も" (B), "奴隷も自由な人も" (R)
decisions.reason: A pair meaning everyone, whatever his standing; the exact sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: "хто мочиться на стіну" at L, as the English Literal keeps the idiom; "кожного чоловіка" at B and R
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the coarse Hebrew idiom for a male, which carries contempt; the other levels give its sense.

source.text: הַמֵּ֨ת לְיָֽרָבְעָ֤ם בָּעִיר֙ יֹאכְל֣וּ הַכְּלָבִ֔ים וְהַמֵּת֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: The one dying of Jeroboam in the city will eat the dogs, and the one dying in the field will eat [the] birds of the heavens; for Yahweh has spoken.

en.L: The one belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city, the dogs will eat; and the one who dies in the field, the birds of the heavens will eat; for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.'
en.B: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city, the dogs will eat, and anyone who dies in the open country, the birds of the sky will eat. For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.'
en.R: Dogs will eat anyone in Jeroboam's family who dies in the city, and birds will eat anyone who dies out in the country. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has said this.'

es.L: Al que de Jeroboam muera en la ciudad, se lo comerán los perros; y al que muera en el campo, se lo comerán las aves de los cielos; porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha dicho”.
es.B: A cualquiera de los de Jeroboam que muera en la ciudad, se lo comerán los perros, y al que muera en el campo, se lo comerán las aves del cielo. Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha dicho”.
es.R: Los perros se comerán a cualquiera de la familia de Jeroboam que muera en la ciudad, y las aves se comerán a cualquiera que muera en el campo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha dicho”.

fr.L: Celui de Jéroboam qui mourra dans la ville, les chiens le mangeront ; et celui qui mourra dans les champs, les oiseaux du ciel le mangeront ; car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé.”
fr.B: Tout homme de la famille de Jéroboam qui mourra dans la ville sera mangé par les chiens, et celui qui mourra dans la campagne sera mangé par les oiseaux du ciel. Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé.”
fr.R: Les chiens mangeront ceux de la famille de Jéroboam qui mourront en ville, et les oiseaux mangeront ceux qui mourront dans la campagne. C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui l’a dit.”

sw.L: Aliye wa Yeroboamu atakayekufa mjini, mbwa watamla; naye atakayekufa shambani, ndege wa angani watamla; kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema.'
sw.B: Yeyote wa Yeroboamu atakayekufa mjini, mbwa watamla, na yeyote atakayekufa nyikani, ndege wa angani watamla. Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema.'
sw.R: Mbwa watamla yeyote wa jamaa ya Yeroboamu atakayekufa mjini, na ndege watamla yeyote atakayekufa porini. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema hivyo.'

vi.L: Kẻ thuộc về Giê-rô-bô-am chết trong thành, chó sẽ ăn; và kẻ chết ngoài đồng, chim trời sẽ ăn; vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.'
vi.B: Ai thuộc nhà Giê-rô-bô-am chết trong thành sẽ bị chó ăn, ai chết ngoài đồng sẽ bị chim trời ăn. Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán vậy.'
vi.R: Người nào trong gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am chết trong thành sẽ bị chó ăn, người nào chết ngoài đồng sẽ bị chim ăn. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán như thế.'

ko.L: 여로보암에게 속한 자로서 성읍에서 죽는 자는 개들이 먹고, 들에서 죽는 자는 하늘의 새들이 먹을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨기 때문이다.'
ko.B: 여로보암에게 속한 사람이 성읍에서 죽으면 개들이 먹고, 들에서 죽으면 공중의 새들이 먹을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다.'
ko.R: 여로보암 집안 사람이 성 안에서 죽으면 개들이 먹고, 들에서 죽으면 새들이 먹을 것이다. 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀이다.'

pt.L: O que pertencer a Jeroboão e morrer na cidade, os cães [o] comerão; e o que morrer no campo, as aves dos céus [o] comerão; porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou.'
pt.B: Quem for de Jeroboão e morrer na cidade será comido pelos cães, e quem morrer em campo aberto será comido pelas aves do céu. Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou.'
pt.R: Os cães vão comer quem da família de Jeroboão morrer na cidade, e as aves vão comer quem morrer no campo. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} falou.'

am.L: ከኢዮርብዓም ወገን በከተማ የሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በሜዳም የሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሯልና።”
am.B: ከኢዮርብዓም ወገን በከተማ የሚሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በገጠርም የሚሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሯልና።”
am.R: ከኢዮርብዓም ቤተሰብ በከተማ የሚሞተውን ሁሉ ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በገጠር የሚሞተውንም ወፎች ይበሉታል። ይህን የተናገረ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።”

hi.L: यारोबाम का जो कोई नगर में मरेगा, उसे कुत्ते खाएँगे; और जो मैदान में मरेगा, उसे आकाश के पक्षी खाएँगे; क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है।'
hi.B: यारोबाम का जो कोई नगर में मरेगा, उसे कुत्ते खाएँगे, और जो खुले मैदान में मरेगा, उसे आकाश के पक्षी खाएँगे। क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह कहा है।'
hi.R: यारोबाम के परिवार का जो कोई नगर में मरेगा, उसे कुत्ते खाएँगे, और जो बाहर खेतों में मरेगा, उसे पक्षी खाएँगे। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह कहा है।'

ru.L: Умершего у Иеровоама в городе съедят псы, а умершего в поле съедят птицы небесные, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал.”
ru.B: Того из дома Иеровоама, кто умрёт в городе, съедят псы, а того, кто умрёт в поле, съедят небесные птицы. Так сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.”
ru.R: Псы съедят каждого из семьи Иеровоама, кто умрёт в городе, а птицы съедят каждого, кто умрёт за городом. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал это.”

ja.L: ヤロブアムに属する者で町で死ぬ者は犬が食らい、野で死ぬ者は天の鳥が食らう。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語られたからである。』
ja.B: ヤロブアムに属する者で、町で死ぬ者は犬が食らい、野で死ぬ者は空の鳥が食らう。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がこう語られたのである。』
ja.R: ヤロブアムの一族で町の中で死ぬ者は、犬に食べられる。町の外で死ぬ者は、鳥に食べられる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がこう言われたのだ。』

uk.L: Того з Єровоамових, хто помре в місті, зʼїдять пси, а того, хто помре в полі, зʼїдять птахи небесні; бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав”.
uk.B: Кожного з Єровоамових, хто помре в місті, зʼїдять пси, а кожного, хто помре в полі, зʼїдять птахи небесні. Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав”.
uk.R: Пси зʼїдять кожного з Єровоамової родини, хто помре в місті, а птахи зʼїдять кожного, хто помре в полі. Це сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}”.

decisions.choice: dogs will eat ... birds will eat: they will lie unburied
decisions.reason: To be left unburied, food for scavenging dogs and birds, was the worst disgrace and a sign of a curse (Deuteronomy 28:26; 1 Samuel 17:44, 46). Dogs in the towns of Israel were half-wild scavengers, not pets. The same sentence is spoken later against the houses of Baasha (16:4) and Ahab (21:24).

decisions.choice: the field: the open country outside the town
decisions.reason: The word means land outside the town walls, whether farmland or wild country. Together, "city" and "field" mean anywhere at all.

decisions.choice: for Yahweh has spoken: the seal on the message
decisions.reason: This closing phrase confirms that the sentence will surely be carried out (Isaiah 1:2; 22:25). It ends the message for Jeroboam that began in verse 7.

decisions.choice: the birds of the heavens (Literal); the birds of the sky (Balanced); birds (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "heavens" here is the sky where birds fly, as in 1 Samuel 17:44. The same wording is used for the houses of Baasha (16:4) and Ahab (21:24). The single quote mark closes the message Ahijah gives for Jeroboam (opened in verse 7); Ahijah's own speech to the woman continues.

decisions.choice: os cães ... as aves dos céus (L), as aves do céu (B), as aves (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (16:4; 21:24): the sentence of the unburied dead (m1) keeps one wording at each level. "Cães" is the word for the half-wild scavengers; "cachorros" is the everyday word for pets. "As aves dos céus" (L) and "as aves do céu" (B) follow 1 Samuel 17:44 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "በከተማ የሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በሜዳም የሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል" (Literal), one wording for the curse each time it returns (16:4; 21:24)
decisions.reason: The curse is repeated on Baasha's and Ahab's houses in the same Hebrew words, so the Amharic keeps one wording at each level.

decisions.choice: "मैदान" (L, B); "बाहर खेतों में" (R)
decisions.reason: The field is the open country outside the town (meaning m2). The dead will lie unburied (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "псы" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is a curse on the unburied dead (m1); "псы" keeps the contempt that 2 Samuel 16:9 in Russian ("мёртвый пёс") has. The same in 16:4.

decisions.choice: "птицы небесные" (L); "небесные птицы" (B); "птицы" (R)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 28:26 in Russian.

decisions.choice: ki YHWH dibber "…が語られたからである" (L), with respect forms inside God's own message
decisions.reason: Here the message names God in the third person (the LORD has spoken), so the usual respect form for God's action is used.

source.text: וְאַ֥תְּ ק֖וּמִי לְכִ֣י לְבֵיתֵ֑ךְ בְּבֹאָ֥ה רַגְלַ֛יִךְ הָעִ֖ירָה וּמֵ֥ת הַיָּֽלֶד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you arise, go to your house; in [the] coming of your feet the city-ward, and will die the child.

en.L: And you, arise, go to your house; when your feet enter the city, the child will die.
en.B: As for you, get up and return to your house. The moment your feet enter the city, the child will die.
en.R: Now get up and go home. As soon as you step into the city, your child will die.

es.L: Y tú, levántate, vete a tu casa; al entrar tus pies en la ciudad, morirá el niño.
es.B: En cuanto a ti, levántate y vuelve a tu casa. En el momento en que tus pies entren en la ciudad, el niño morirá.
es.R: Ahora levántate y vete a casa. En cuanto pongas el pie en la ciudad, tu hijo morirá.

fr.L: Et toi, lève-toi, va dans ta maison ; quand tes pieds entreront dans la ville, l’enfant mourra.
fr.B: Quant à toi, lève-toi et retourne chez toi. Au moment où tes pieds entreront dans la ville, l’enfant mourra.
fr.R: Maintenant, lève-toi et rentre chez toi. Dès que tu entreras dans la ville, ton enfant mourra.

sw.L: Nawe, inuka, uende nyumbani kwako; miguu yako itakapoingia mjini, mtoto atakufa.
sw.B: Lakini wewe, inuka urudi nyumbani kwako. Mara miguu yako itakapoingia mjini, mtoto atakufa.
sw.R: Sasa inuka urudi nyumbani. Mara utakapoingia mjini, mtoto wako atakufa.

vi.L: Còn bà, hãy đứng dậy về nhà mình; khi chân bà vào thành, thì đứa trẻ sẽ chết.
vi.B: Còn bà, hãy đứng dậy trở về nhà. Khi chân bà vừa bước vào thành, đứa trẻ sẽ chết.
vi.R: Bây giờ bà hãy đứng dậy về nhà. Ngay khi bà bước vào thành, con bà sẽ chết.

ko.L: 그러니 당신은 일어나 당신 집으로 가시오. 당신의 발이 성읍에 들어갈 때에 그 아이가 죽을 것이오.
ko.B: 이제 당신은 일어나 집으로 돌아가시오. 당신이 성읍에 발을 들여놓는 순간 그 아이는 죽을 것이오.
ko.R: 이제 일어나 집으로 가시오. 당신이 성 안에 들어서자마자 당신 아이는 죽을 것이오.

pt.L: E você, levante-se, vá para a sua casa; quando os seus pés entrarem na cidade, o menino morrerá.
pt.B: Quanto a você, levante-se e volte para casa. No momento em que os seus pés entrarem na cidade, o menino morrerá.
pt.R: Agora, levante-se e vá para casa. Assim que você puser os pés na cidade, o seu filho vai morrer.

am.L: አንቺም ተነሺ፤ ወደ ቤትሽ ሂጂ፤ እግሮችሽ ወደ ከተማዪቱ በገቡ ጊዜ ብላቴናው ይሞታል።
am.B: አንቺ ግን ተነሥተሽ ወደ ቤትሽ ተመለሺ። እግርሽ ወደ ከተማዪቱ እንደ ገባ ልጁ ይሞታል።
am.R: አሁን ተነሥተሽ ወደ ቤትሽ ሂጂ። ወደ ከተማዪቱ እንደ ገባሽ ልጅሽ ይሞታል።

hi.L: और तुम उठो, अपने घर जाओ; जब तुम्हारे पाँव नगर में पहुँचेंगे, तब बालक मर जाएगा।
hi.B: अब तुम उठकर अपने घर लौट जाओ। जिस क्षण तुम्हारे पाँव नगर में पड़ेंगे, उसी क्षण बालक मर जाएगा।
hi.R: अब उठो और घर जाओ। जैसे ही तुम नगर में क़दम रखोगी, तुम्हारा बच्चा मर जाएगा।

ru.L: А ты встань, иди в свой дом; когда войдут твои ноги в город, умрёт ребёнок.
ru.B: А ты встань и возвращайся в свой дом. Как только твои ноги ступят в город, ребёнок умрёт.
ru.R: А теперь вставай и иди домой. Как только ты войдёшь в город, твой ребёнок умрёт.

ja.L: そして、あなたは立って、自分の家へ行きなさい。あなたの足が町に入るとき、その子は死ぬ。
ja.B: あなたは立って、家へ帰りなさい。あなたの足が町に入ったとき、その子は死ぬ。
ja.R: さあ、立って家に帰りなさい。あなたが町に足を踏み入れたとたんに、あなたの子は死ぬ。

uk.L: А ти встань, іди до свого дому; коли твої ноги ввійдуть у місто, помре дитина.
uk.B: А ти встань і вертайся до свого дому. Щойно твої ноги ступлять у місто, дитина помре.
uk.R: Тепер встань і йди додому. Щойно ти ввійдеш у місто, твоя дитина помре.

decisions.choice: and you: Ahijah turns from the message for Jeroboam to the woman herself
decisions.reason: The pronoun stands first for emphasis. After the message she must carry to her husband (verses 7-11), Ahijah answers the question she came with (verse 3).

decisions.choice: when your feet enter the city, the child will die: the sign that the word is true
decisions.reason: The timing of the boy's death will show that Ahijah spoke for Yahweh (Deuteronomy 18:22). It happens exactly so in verse 17.

decisions.choice: as soon as you step into the city (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable puts "your feet enter" in everyday words.

source.text: וְסָֽפְדוּ־ל֤וֹ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְקָבְר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ כִּֽי־זֶ֣ה לְבַדּ֔וֹ יָבֹ֥א לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם אֶל־קָ֑בֶר יַ֣עַן נִמְצָא־ב֞וֹ דָּבָ֣ר ט֗וֹב אֶל־יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּבֵ֥ית יָרָבְעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will mourn for him all Israel and bury him, for this [one] alone of Jeroboam will come to a grave, because was found in him a thing good toward Yahweh [the] God of Israel in [the] house of Jeroboam.

en.L: And all Israel will mourn for him and bury him, for this [one] alone of Jeroboam's will come to a grave, because in him was found something good toward {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.
en.B: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will be laid in a grave, because in him something good toward {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, has been found in the house of Jeroboam.
en.R: All the people of Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He will be the only one in Jeroboam's family to be buried in a grave. In all of Jeroboam's family, he is the only one in whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, has found anything good.

es.L: Y todo Israel hará duelo por él y lo sepultará, porque solo este de los de Jeroboam llegará al sepulcro, porque en él se ha hallado algo bueno para con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, en la casa de Jeroboam.
es.B: Todo Israel hará duelo por él y lo sepultará. Él es el único de los de Jeroboam que será puesto en un sepulcro, porque en él se ha hallado algo bueno para con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, en la casa de Jeroboam.
es.R: Todo el pueblo de Israel hará duelo por él y lo sepultará. Él será el único de la familia de Jeroboam que será enterrado en una tumba. De toda la familia de Jeroboam, él es el único en quien {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, ha hallado algo bueno.

fr.L: Et tout Israël se lamentera sur lui et l’enterrera, car lui seul de [la famille de] Jéroboam entrera dans un tombeau, parce qu’on a trouvé en lui quelque chose de bon envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, dans la maison de Jéroboam.
fr.B: Tout Israël le pleurera et l’enterrera. C’est le seul de la famille de Jéroboam qui sera mis dans un tombeau, parce qu’en lui, dans la maison de Jéroboam, s’est trouvé quelque chose de bon envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout le peuple d’Israël le pleurera et l’enterrera. Ce sera le seul de la famille de Jéroboam à être enterré dans un tombeau. Dans toute la famille de Jéroboam, c’est le seul en qui {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, a trouvé quelque chose de bon.

sw.L: Israeli wote watamwombolezea na kumzika, kwa maana huyu peke yake wa Yeroboamu atafika kaburini, kwa sababu ndani yake limeonekana jambo jema kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, katika nyumba ya Yeroboamu.
sw.B: Israeli wote watamwombolezea na kumzika. Yeye ndiye peke yake wa Yeroboamu atakayewekwa kaburini, kwa sababu ndani yake limeonekana jambo jema kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, katika nyumba ya Yeroboamu.
sw.R: Watu wote wa Israeli watamwombolezea na kumzika. Yeye peke yake katika jamaa ya Yeroboamu atazikwa kaburini. Katika jamaa yote ya Yeroboamu, yeye peke yake ndiye ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, ameona jema lolote ndani yake.

vi.L: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ than khóc nó và chôn nó, vì trong nhà Giê-rô-bô-am chỉ một mình nó sẽ được vào mồ mả, bởi trong nhà Giê-rô-bô-am chỉ nơi nó là tìm thấy điều tốt lành đối với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ than khóc và chôn cất nó. Trong nhà Giê-rô-bô-am chỉ một mình nó được chôn trong mộ, vì trong nhà Giê-rô-bô-am chỉ nơi nó là có điều tốt lành đối với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ than khóc và chôn cất nó. Trong gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am, chỉ một mình nó được chôn trong mộ. Trong cả gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am, chỉ nơi nó {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, mới thấy có điều tốt lành.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘이 그를 위해 슬퍼하며 그를 묻을 것이오. 여로보암에게 속한 자 가운데 오직 이 [아이]만 무덤에 들어갈 것이오. 여로보암의 집에서 그에게만 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 향한 선한 것이 발견되었기 때문이오.
ko.B: 온 이스라엘이 그를 위해 슬퍼하며 그를 묻을 것이오. 여로보암에게 속한 사람 가운데 무덤에 묻힐 사람은 그 아이뿐이오. 여로보암의 집안에서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 향한 선한 것이 그 아이에게서만 발견되었기 때문이오.
ko.R: 온 이스라엘 백성이 그를 위해 슬퍼하며 그를 묻어 줄 것이오. 여로보암 집안에서 무덤에 묻힐 사람은 그 아이 하나뿐이오. 여로보암 집안 모든 사람 가운데 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 좋게 보신 사람은 그 아이 하나뿐이기 때문이오.

pt.L: E todo o Israel chorará por ele e o sepultará, porque só este, dos de Jeroboão, entrará num sepulcro, porque nele se achou algo bom para com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, na casa de Jeroboão.
pt.B: Todo o Israel chorará por ele e o sepultará. Ele é o único de Jeroboão que será posto num túmulo, porque na casa de Jeroboão foi achado nele algo de bom para com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.R: Todo o povo de Israel vai chorar por ele e sepultá-lo. Ele vai ser o único da família de Jeroboão a ser sepultado num túmulo. Em toda a família de Jeroboão, ele é o único em quem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, achou alguma coisa boa.

am.L: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ያለቅሱለታል፤ ይቀብሩታልም፤ በኢዮርብዓም ቤት ለእስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በጎ ነገር በእርሱ ስለ ተገኘ ከኢዮርብዓም [ወገን] ይህ ብቻ ወደ መቃብር ይገባልና።
am.B: እስራኤል ሁሉ ያለቅሱለታል፤ ይቀብሩታልም። በኢዮርብዓም ቤት ለእስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የሚሆን በጎ ነገር በእርሱ ስለ ተገኘ ከኢዮርብዓም ወገን በመቃብር የሚቀበረው እርሱ ብቻ ነው።
am.R: የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ ያለቅሱለታል፤ ይቀብሩታልም። ከኢዮርብዓም ቤተሰብ በመቃብር የሚቀበረው እርሱ ብቻ ይሆናል። የእስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከኢዮርብዓም ቤተሰብ ሁሉ መልካም ነገር ያገኘው በእርሱ ብቻ ነውና።

hi.L: और सारा इस्राएल उसके लिए विलाप करेगा और उसे मिट्टी देगा; क्योंकि यारोबाम [के लोगों] में से केवल यही क़ब्र में पहुँचेगा, क्योंकि यारोबाम के घराने में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल के परमेश्वर की ओर कुछ भली बात उसी में पाई गई।
hi.B: सारा इस्राएल उसके लिए विलाप करेगा और उसे मिट्टी देगा। यारोबाम के लोगों में से केवल यही क़ब्र में रखा जाएगा, क्योंकि यारोबाम के घराने में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, की ओर कुछ भलाई उसी में पाई गई है।
hi.R: इस्राएल के सब लोग उसके लिए शोक मनाएँगे और उसे दफ़नाएँगे। यारोबाम के परिवार में केवल वही होगा जो क़ब्र में दफ़नाया जाएगा। यारोबाम के सारे परिवार में केवल उसी में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर, ने कुछ भलाई पाई है।

ru.L: И будет оплакивать его весь Израиль, и похоронят его, потому что только он один из [дома] Иеровоама войдёт в гробницу, потому что в нём нашлось нечто доброе перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, Богом Израиля, в доме Иеровоама.
ru.B: Весь Израиль будет оплакивать его, и его похоронят. Из всех, кто у Иеровоама, только его положат в гробницу, потому что в нём нашлось нечто доброе перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, Богом Израиля, в доме Иеровоама.
ru.R: Весь народ Израиля будет оплакивать его и похоронит. Только его одного из семьи Иеровоама похоронят в гробнице. Во всей семье Иеровоама только в нём {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог Израиля, нашёл что-то доброе.

ja.L: そして全イスラエルが彼のために嘆き、彼を葬るだろう。ヤロブアムに属する者のうち、この者だけが墓に入るからである。ヤロブアムの家の中で、彼のうちに、イスラエルの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に対する良いことが見いだされたからである。
ja.B: 全イスラエルは彼のために嘆き悲しみ、彼を葬るだろう。ヤロブアムに属する者のうち、墓に葬られるのはこの子だけである。ヤロブアムの家の中で、この子にだけ、イスラエルの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に対する良いものが見いだされたからである。
ja.R: イスラエルの人々はみな、この子のために泣き悲しみ、この子を葬るだろう。ヤロブアムの一族で、墓に葬られるのはこの子だけだ。ヤロブアムの一族の中で、イスラエルの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が良いものを見つけられたのは、この子だけだからである。

uk.L: І оплакуватиме його весь Ізраїль, і поховають його, бо тільки цей з Єровоамових прийде до гробу, бо в ньому знайшлося щось добре перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, Богом Ізраїля, в домі Єровоама.
uk.B: Увесь Ізраїль оплакуватиме його і поховає його. Він єдиний з Єровоамових, кого покладуть у гріб, бо в Єровоамовому домі тільки в ньому знайшлося щось добре перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, Богом Ізраїля.
uk.R: Увесь народ Ізраїлю оплакуватиме його і поховає його. Він буде єдиним з Єровоамової родини, кого поховають у гробі. З усієї Єровоамової родини тільки в ньому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог Ізраїля, знайшов щось добре.

decisions.choice: he alone will come to a grave: his early death is a mercy
decisions.reason: Every other male of Jeroboam's house will die by violence and lie unburied (verses 10-11). This boy alone will die at home, be mourned by the whole nation and receive an honorable burial (verse 18). His death spares him the end of his family.

decisions.choice: something good toward Yahweh: some goodness or faithfulness Yahweh saw in him
decisions.reason: The text does not say what the good thing was. It may have been the boy's own loyalty or disposition toward Yahweh. The point is the contrast with the rest of the house.

decisions.choice: In all of Jeroboam's family, he is the only one in whom the LORD has found anything good (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable turns the passive "was found in him" into an active sentence with Yahweh as the one who finds, and brings "in the house of Jeroboam" forward to make the contrast clear.

decisions.choice: "भली बात" (L); "भलाई" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Some goodness or faithfulness Yahweh saw in him (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: safad "嘆く" (L), "嘆き悲しむ" (B), "泣き悲しむ" (R)
decisions.reason: The public mourning for the dead.

source.text: וְהֵקִים֩ יְהוָ֨ה ל֥וֹ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַכְרִ֛ית אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם זֶ֣ה הַיּ֑וֹם וּמֶ֖ה גַּם־עָֽתָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will raise up Yahweh for himself a king over Israel who will cut off [the] house of Jeroboam this [is] the day; and what? even now.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will raise up for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} a king over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This [is] the day; and what? Even now.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will raise up a king of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own over Israel, and that king will cut off Jeroboam's house. This is the day; indeed, it has already begun.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will choose a king over Israel who will destroy Jeroboam's family. That day has come; in fact, it has already begun.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se levantará para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} un rey sobre Israel que cortará la casa de Jeroboam. Este [es] el día; ¿y qué? Ya ahora.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} levantará un rey {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}} sobre Israel, y ese rey exterminará la casa de Jeroboam. Este es el día; en verdad, ya ha comenzado.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escogerá un rey sobre Israel que destruirá a la familia de Jeroboam. Ese día ha llegado; de hecho, ya ha comenzado.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} suscitera pour {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} un roi sur Israël, qui retranchera la maison de Jéroboam. C’[est] le jour ; et quoi ? Dès maintenant.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} suscitera sur Israël un roi de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} choix, qui retranchera la maison de Jéroboam. C’est aujourd’hui ; oui, cela a déjà commencé.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} choisira un roi sur Israël, qui détruira la famille de Jéroboam. Ce jour est arrivé ; en fait, cela a déjà commencé.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atajiinulia mfalme juu ya Israeli atakayeikatilia mbali nyumba ya Yeroboamu. Hii [ndiyo] siku; na nini? Hata sasa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atajiinulia mfalme wake mwenyewe juu ya Israeli, naye ataikatilia mbali nyumba ya Yeroboamu. Siku ndiyo hii; naam, imekwisha kuanza.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atamchagua mfalme juu ya Israeli atakayeiangamiza jamaa ya Yeroboamu. Siku hiyo imefika; kwa kweli, imekwisha kuanza.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ dấy lên cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên, là người sẽ diệt nhà Giê-rô-bô-am. Đây [là] ngày ấy; và gì nữa? Ngay bây giờ!
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ dấy lên một vua của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên Y-sơ-ra-ên, và vua ấy sẽ diệt nhà Giê-rô-bô-am. Ngày ấy là đây; thật vậy, việc ấy đã bắt đầu rồi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chọn một vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên, và vua ấy sẽ tiêu diệt gia đình Giê-rô-bô-am. Ngày ấy đã đến; thật ra, việc ấy đã bắt đầu rồi.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신을 위하여 이스라엘 위에 한 왕을 일으키실 것인데, 그가 여로보암의 집을 끊어 버릴 것이오. 이것이 그날이오. 그러면 무엇이오? 바로 지금이오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신의 왕을 이스라엘 위에 세우실 것이고, 그 왕이 여로보암의 집안을 끊어 버릴 것이오. 그날이 왔소. 아니, 이미 시작되었소.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 다스릴 왕을 뽑으실 것이오. 그 왕이 여로보암의 집안을 없앨 것이오. 그날이 왔소. 사실 벌써 시작되었소.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} levantará para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} um rei sobre Israel, que eliminará a casa de Jeroboão. Este [é] o dia; e o quê? Já agora.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} levantará para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} um rei sobre Israel, e esse rei eliminará a casa de Jeroboão. Este é o dia; na verdade, isso já começou.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai escolher um rei para Israel, e esse rei vai destruir a família de Jeroboão. Esse dia já chegou; na verdade, já começou.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም የኢዮርብዓምን ቤት የሚያጠፋ ንጉሥ በእስራኤል ላይ ለራሱ ያስነሣል። ይህ ቀን [ነው]፤ ምንድን ነው? አሁን እንኳ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የራሱን ንጉሥ በእስራኤል ላይ ያስነሣል፤ ያም ንጉሥ የኢዮርብዓምን ቤት ያጠፋል። ቀኑ ዛሬ ነው፤ እንዲያውም አሁኑኑ ጀምሯል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የኢዮርብዓምን ቤተሰብ የሚያጠፋ ንጉሥ በእስራኤል ላይ ይመርጣል። ያ ቀን ደርሷል፤ እንዲያውም አሁኑኑ ጀምሯል።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने लिए इस्राएल पर एक राजा खड़ा करेंगे, जो यारोबाम के घराने को काट डालेगा। यही वह दिन [है]; और क्या? अभी भी।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल पर अपनी ओर से एक राजा खड़ा करेंगे, और वह यारोबाम के घराने को काट डालेगा। यही वह दिन है; बल्कि यह अभी से हो रहा है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल पर एक राजा चुनेंगे, जो यारोबाम के परिवार को नाश कर देगा। वह दिन आ गया है; बल्कि यह अभी से शुरू हो चुका है।

ru.L: И воздвигнет себе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} царя над Израилем, который истребит дом Иеровоама. Вот этот день; и что? Даже теперь.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} воздвигнет себе царя над Израилем, и этот царь истребит дом Иеровоама. Это уже сегодня; более того, это уже началось.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} выберет царя над Израилем, который уничтожит семью Иеровоама. Этот день пришёл; более того, это уже началось.

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分のためにイスラエルの上に一人の王を起こされ、彼はヤロブアムの家を断つ。これがその日である。そして何か？今すでに。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分のために、イスラエルの上に一人の王を起こされる。その王がヤロブアムの家を断つ。今日がその日である。いや、すでに始まっている。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、イスラエルを治める王をお選びになる。その王がヤロブアムの一族を滅ぼす。その日はもう来ている。実は、もう始まっているのだ。

uk.L: І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} підніме собі царя над Ізраїлем, який винищить дім Єровоама. Ось той день; а що? Навіть тепер.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} поставить над Ізраїлем свого царя, і той цар винищить Єровоамів дім. Це той день; ба більше, це вже почалося.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вибере над Ізраїлем царя, який знищить Єровоамову родину. Цей день настав; справді, це вже почалося.

decisions.choice: a king who will cut off the house of Jeroboam: Baasha
decisions.reason: Baasha killed Jeroboam's son Nadab and struck down the whole house of Jeroboam, "according to the word of Yahweh that he spoke by the hand of his servant Ahijah" (15:27-30).

decisions.choice: this is the day; and what? even now: the judgment has already begun
alternatives: who will cut off the house of Jeroboam on that day; and what now? even now
this is the day! What am I saying? It is now
decisions.reason: These closing words are very short and hard to read. They seem to say that the day of judgment is not far off but already here, beginning with the boy's death. Other readings take them as "this is the day, and what [more]? Even now [it is happening]", or join "this day" to the cutting off ("who will cut off the house of Jeroboam on this day"). All of them stress how near the judgment is.

decisions.choice: indeed, it has already begun (Balanced); in fact, it has already begun (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the broken phrase "and what? even now" (m2). Literal keeps its bare form.

decisions.choice: a king of his own (Balanced); will choose a king (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "raise up for himself" in plainer words: Yahweh brings the king to power for his own purpose.

decisions.choice: "Este [es] el día; ¿y qué? Ya ahora" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's broken phrase, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable give its sense, that the judgment has already begun.

decisions.choice: atajiinulia (Literal, Balanced), without a span
decisions.reason: The English "himself" and "his own" are free pronouns with a span; Swahili says it with the reflexive "-ji-" in the verb, which takes no span.

decisions.choice: e o quê? Já agora (L); na verdade, isso já começou (B, R)
decisions.reason: The broken closing words (m2) are kept bare at Literal and given their likely sense at Balanced and Readable, as the English does. Balanced keeps "levantará para si" with a deity_pronoun span, where the English says "a king of his own".

decisions.choice: "ይህ ቀን [ነው]፤ ምንድን ነው? አሁን እንኳ።" (This is the day; and what? Even now.)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the abrupt Hebrew, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable give the sense that the judgment has already begun.

decisions.choice: "यही वह दिन [है]; और क्या? अभी भी" (L); "बल्कि यह अभी से हो रहा है" (B); "अभी से शुरू हो चुका है" (R)
decisions.reason: The terse Hebrew means the judgment has already begun (meaning m2); Literal keeps its broken words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Within Ahijah's own words God is spoken of with honorific forms ("खड़ा करेंगे")
decisions.reason: Ahijah leaves the oracle ("I") and speaks of Yahweh in the third person; God spoken of takes honorific forms, as the style guide asks.

decisions.choice: "воздвигнет себе" without a span
decisions.reason: The reflexive "себе" takes no deity_pronoun span, as the style guide sets, where the English writes a span on "himself", "his".

decisions.choice: "Вот этот день; и что? Даже теперь." (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the abrupt Hebrew words; the other levels say that the judgment has already begun (m2).

decisions.choice: "これがその日である。そして何か？今すでに。" (L), "今日がその日である。いや、すでに始まっている。" (B, R alike)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is abrupt and its sense uncertain; Literal keeps its broken shape, Balanced and Readable follow the reading of the meaning decision.

source.text: וְהִכָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנ֣וּד הַקָּנֶה֮ בַּמַּיִם֒ וְנָתַ֣שׁ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֠עַל הָאֲדָמָ֨ה הַטּוֹבָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַן֙ לַאֲב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְזֵרָ֖ם מֵעֵ֣בֶר לַנָּהָ֑ר יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ אֶת־אֲשֵׁ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם מַכְעִיסִ֖ים אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will strike Yahweh Israel as sways the reed in the water, and he will uproot Israel from on the ground the good the this which he gave to their fathers, and he will scatter them from beyond the River, because they made their Asherah poles provoking Yahweh to anger.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike Israel as the reed sways in the water, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will uproot Israel from this good land that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave to their fathers, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to anger.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will strike Israel until it sways like a reed in the water. He will pull Israel up by the roots from this good land {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave their ancestors and scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, because they have made their Asherah poles and provoked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to anger.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will strike Israel, and it will shake like a reed in a stream. He will pull Israel up by the roots out of this good land that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave to their ancestors. He will scatter them to the far side of the Euphrates River. This is because they made poles used to worship Asherah and made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} angry.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} herirá a Israel como se mece la caña en el agua, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} arrancará a Israel de esta buena tierra que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dio a sus padres, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los esparcirá más allá del Río, porque han hecho sus postes de Aserá, provocando a ira {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} herirá a Israel hasta que se mezca como una caña en el agua. Arrancará de raíz a Israel de esta buena tierra que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dio a sus antepasados, y los esparcirá más allá del río Éufrates, porque han hecho sus postes de Aserá y han provocado a ira {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} herirá a Israel, y se sacudirá como una caña en un arroyo. Arrancará de raíz a Israel de esta buena tierra que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dio a sus antepasados. Los esparcirá al otro lado del río Éufrates. Esto será porque hicieron postes que usaban para adorar a Aserá, y así hicieron enojar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera Israël comme le roseau s’agite dans l’eau, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} arrachera Israël de ce bon pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné à leurs pères, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les dispersera au-delà du Fleuve, parce qu’ils ont fait leurs poteaux d’Ashéra, en irritant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera Israël, et il sera secoué comme un roseau dans l’eau. Il arrachera Israël de ce bon pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné à leurs ancêtres et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les dispersera au-delà de l’Euphrate, parce qu’ils ont fait leurs poteaux d’Ashéra et ont irrité {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera Israël, et il tremblera comme un roseau dans un ruisseau. Il arrachera Israël de ce bon pays qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné à leurs ancêtres. Il les dispersera de l’autre côté de l’Euphrate. Tout cela parce qu’ils ont fait des poteaux sacrés pour adorer la déesse Ashéra et qu’ils ont mis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en colère.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atampiga Israeli kama unyasi uyumbavyo majini, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atamng'oa Israeli kutoka katika nchi hii nzuri aliyowapa baba zao, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawatawanya ng'ambo ya Mto, kwa sababu wamefanya miti yao ya Ashera, wakimkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atampiga Israeli mpaka ayumbe kama unyasi majini. Atamng'oa Israeli kutoka katika nchi hii nzuri aliyowapa babu zao, na kuwatawanya ng'ambo ya mto Frati, kwa sababu wametengeneza miti yao ya Ashera na kumkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atampiga Israeli, naye atatikisika kama unyasi katika kijito. Atamng'oa Israeli kutoka katika nchi hii nzuri aliyowapa babu zao. Atawatawanya mbali ng'ambo ya mto Frati. Hii ni kwa sababu walitengeneza nguzo za kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera na kumkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đánh Y-sơ-ra-ên như cây sậy lay động trong nước; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nhổ Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi đất tốt lành này mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ phụ họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phân tán họ ra bên kia Sông, vì họ đã làm các trụ A-sê-ra của họ mà chọc giận {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đánh Y-sơ-ra-ên, khiến nó lay động như cây sậy trong nước. Ngài sẽ nhổ Y-sơ-ra-ên khỏi đất tốt lành này mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ, và phân tán họ ra bên kia sông Ơ-phơ-rát, vì họ đã làm các trụ A-sê-ra mà chọc giận {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đánh Y-sơ-ra-ên, và Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ rung chuyển như cây sậy trong dòng nước. Ngài sẽ nhổ Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi đất tốt lành này mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ. Ngài sẽ phân tán họ sang tận bên kia sông Ơ-phơ-rát. Đó là vì họ đã dựng các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra và làm cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 치셔서, 갈대가 물에서 흔들리듯이 [하실 것이오]. 그분께서 그들의 조상들에게 주신 이 좋은 땅에서 이스라엘을 뽑아내시고, 그들을 그 강 너머로 흩으실 것이오. 그들이 아세라 목상들을 만들어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 노엽게 했기 때문이오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 치셔서, 물속의 갈대처럼 흔들리게 하실 것이오. 그분께서 그들의 조상들에게 주신 이 좋은 땅에서 이스라엘을 뿌리째 뽑아 유프라테스강 너머로 흩으실 것이오. 그들이 아세라 목상들을 만들어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 노엽게 했기 때문이오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 치실 것이오. 그러면 이스라엘은 시냇물 속의 갈대처럼 흔들릴 것이오. 그분께서는 그들의 조상들에게 주신 이 좋은 땅에서 이스라엘을 뿌리째 뽑아내실 것이오. 그리고 그들을 유프라테스강 건너편 먼 곳으로 흩어 버리실 것이오. 그들이 아세라 여신을 섬기려고 목상들을 만들어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 화나게 했기 때문이오.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ferirá Israel como o junco balança na água, e arrancará Israel desta boa terra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu aos pais deles, e os espalhará além do Rio, porque fizeram os seus postes de Aserá, provocando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} à ira.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ferirá Israel até que balance como um junco na água. Ele arrancará Israel pela raiz desta boa terra que deu aos antepassados deles e os espalhará além do rio Eufrates, porque fizeram os seus postes de Aserá e provocaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} à ira.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai ferir Israel, e Israel vai balançar como um junco num riacho. Ele vai arrancar Israel pela raiz desta boa terra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu aos antepassados deles. Vai espalhá-los para o outro lado do rio Eufrates. Isso porque eles fizeram postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá e deixaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} irado.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሸምበቆ በውኃ እንደሚወዛወዝ እስራኤልን ይመታል፤ ለአባቶቻቸውም ከሰጣት ከዚህች መልካም ምድር እስራኤልን ይነቅላል፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እያስቆጡ አሼራዎቻቸውን ስለ ሠሩ ከወንዙ ማዶ ይበትናቸዋል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እስራኤልን ይመታዋል፤ እንደ ሸምበቆ በውኃ ውስጥ ይወዛወዛል። ለአባቶቻቸው ከሰጣት ከዚህች መልካም ምድር እስራኤልን ይነቅላል፤ የአሼራ ማምለኪያ እንጨቶቻቸውን ሠርተው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ስላስቆጡ ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ማዶ ይበትናቸዋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እስራኤልን ይመታዋል፤ እስራኤልም በወንዝ ውስጥ እንዳለ ሸምበቆ ይንቀጠቀጣል። ለአባቶቻቸው ከሰጣት ከዚህች መልካም ምድር ነቅሎ ያወጣቸዋል። ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ማዶ ይበትናቸዋል። ይህም የሚሆነው አሼራ የምትባለውን ሴት አምላክ ለማምለክ የሚጠቀሙባቸውን የእንጨት ዘንጎች ሠርተው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ስላስቆጡ ነው።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल को ऐसा मारेंगे जैसे जल में सरकंडा हिलता है, और वे इस्राएल को इस अच्छी भूमि पर से जो उन्होंने उनके पूर्वजों को दी थी उखाड़ फेंकेंगे, और उन्हें महानद के पार तितर-बितर कर देंगे, क्योंकि उन्होंने अपने अशेरा के खंभे बनाकर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को क्रोध दिलाया है।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल को ऐसा मारेंगे कि वह जल में सरकंडे के समान डोलने लगेगा। वे इस्राएल को इस अच्छी भूमि से, जो उन्होंने उनके पूर्वजों को दी थी, जड़ से उखाड़ देंगे और फ़रात नदी के पार तितर-बितर कर देंगे, क्योंकि उन्होंने अपने अशेरा के खंभे बनाकर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को क्रोध दिलाया है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल को ऐसा मारेंगे कि वह नाले में उगे सरकंडे के समान काँपने लगेगा। जो अच्छी भूमि उन्होंने उनके पूर्वजों को दी थी, उससे वे इस्राएल को जड़ से उखाड़ देंगे। वे उन्हें फ़रात नदी के उस पार दूर-दूर तक बिखेर देंगे। यह इसलिए होगा कि उन्होंने अशेरा देवी की पूजा के लिए खंभे खड़े किए और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को क्रोधित किया।

ru.L: И поразит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Израиль, как колеблется тростник в воде, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вырвет Израиль из этой доброй земли, которую {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал их отцам, и рассеет их за Рекой, за то, что они сделали свои столбы Ашеры, гневя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поразит Израиль, так что он будет колебаться, как тростник в воде. Он вырвет Израиль с корнем из этой доброй земли, которую {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал их отцам, и рассеет их за рекой Евфрат, потому что они сделали свои столбы Ашеры и прогневали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поразит Израиль, и он будет качаться, как тростник в реке. Он вырвет Израиль с корнем из этой хорошей земли, которую {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал их предкам. Он рассеет их по ту сторону реки Евфрат. Это будет потому, что они поставили деревянные столбы для поклонения богине Ашере и разгневали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、水の中で葦が揺れるようにイスラエルを打ち、彼らの先祖たちに与えられたこの良い土地からイスラエルを引き抜き、川の向こうに彼らを散らされる。彼らが自分たちのアシェラ像を造り、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を怒らせたからである。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はイスラエルを打ち、水の中の葦のように揺り動かされる。そして、先祖に与えられたこの良い土地からイスラエルを根こそぎにし、ユーフラテス川の向こうに散らされる。彼らがアシェラ像を造り、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を怒らせたからである。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はイスラエルを打たれる。イスラエルは、川の水の中の葦のように揺れ動く。そして、先祖たちに与えられたこの良い土地から、イスラエルを根こそぎ引き抜き、ユーフラテス川の向こうへ散らされる。彼らが女神アシェラを拝むための木の柱を作って、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を怒らせたからだ。

uk.L: І вдарить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Ізраїль, як хитається очерет у воді, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вирве Ізраїль з цієї доброї землі, яку {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав їхнім батькам, і розвіє їх за Ріку, бо вони зробили собі ашери, гніваючи {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вдарить Ізраїль так, що він хитатиметься, як очерет у воді. Він вирве Ізраїль з корінням з цієї доброї землі, яку {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав їхнім предкам, і розвіє їх за ріку Євфрат, бо вони зробили собі стовпи Ашери і гнівили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вдарить Ізраїль, і він хитатиметься, як очерет у потоці. Він вирве Ізраїль з корінням з цієї доброї землі, яку {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав їхнім предкам. Він розвіє їх по той бік ріки Євфрат. Це тому, що вони зробили стовпи для поклоніння Ашері і розгнівали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: as the reed sways in the water: Israel will be shaken and unstable
decisions.reason: A reed in a stream bends with every current and has no firm footing. The picture is of a nation tossed about by Yahweh's blows, never secure.

decisions.choice: uproot ... scatter them beyond the River: exile from the land
decisions.reason: "The River" is the Euphrates. Moses warned that if Israel turned to other gods, Yahweh would uproot them from the land (Deuteronomy 29:27) and scatter them among the nations (Deuteronomy 28:64). It happened when Assyria carried the northern kingdom away (2 Kings 17:6, 23).

decisions.choice: Asherah poles: wooden poles or trees set up to worship the goddess Asherah
decisions.reason: Asherah was a Canaanite goddess. Her sign was a wooden pole or tree set up beside an altar, which the law commanded Israel to cut down (Exodus 34:13; Deuteronomy 7:5; 16:21). The poles here are the first mention in Kings of this worship in the northern kingdom.

decisions.choice: the River (Literal); the Euphrates River (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the river, as 2 Samuel 10:16 does (m2).

decisions.choice: poles used to worship Asherah (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for asherim in these books: "Asherah poles" at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: "sus postes de Aserá" (L, B); "postes que usaban para adorar a Aserá" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms table sets; Readable explains, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "el Río" (L); "el río Éufrates" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's name for the great river; Balanced and Readable name it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "poteaux d’Ashéra" (L, B); "poteaux sacrés pour adorer la déesse Ashéra" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note; Readable says what the poles were for, as the English Readable does. For the whole block.

decisions.choice: "le Fleuve" (L); "l’Euphrate" (B, R)
decisions.reason: French names the Euphrates "le Fleuve" when the Hebrew says only "the River"; Balanced and Readable name it, as the English.

decisions.choice: miti ya Ashera (Literal, Balanced); nguzo za kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Asherah poles are "miti ya Ashera" as in the Swahili Deuteronomy, and Readable says what they were for, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: mto Frati
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the River" ("Mto"); Balanced and Readable name it "mto Frati", the Euphrates, as the published books do.

decisions.choice: "các trụ A-sê-ra" (L, B); "các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the Asherah poles, used through this block; Readable says what they were for.

decisions.choice: "Sông" with a capital (L); "sông Ơ-phơ-rát" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the River" as a name, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable name the Euphrates.

decisions.choice: "아세라 목상" (L, B); "아세라 여신을 섬기려고 ... 목상" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the Asherah poles; Readable says what they were for. "유프라테스강" is the form the Korean Genesis and Revelation already use.

decisions.choice: os postes de Aserá (L, B); postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá (R); o Rio (L), o rio Eufrates (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the goddess's wooden symbol (m3) is "poste de Aserá", as Judges 6:25 and Deuteronomy 16:21 have it in Portuguese, with Readable's explanation; "the River" is named at Balanced and Readable as 2 Samuel 10:16 does in Portuguese (m2).

decisions.choice: "አሼራዎች" (Literal); "የአሼራ ማምለኪያ እንጨቶች" (Balanced); "አሼራ የምትባለውን ሴት አምላክ ለማምለክ የሚጠቀሙባቸው የእንጨት ዘንጎች" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Amharic Exodus 34:13 at each level, so Asherah poles read the same through Kings. "the River" is "ወንዙ" (Literal), "ኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ" (Balanced, Readable), as the Pentateuch settled.

decisions.choice: "ለአባቶቻቸው" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has none here; "fathers" are the forefathers who received the land.

decisions.choice: "अशेरा के खंभे" (L, B); "अशेरा देवी की पूजा के लिए खंभे" (R)
decisions.reason: The history-books note's term for the Asherim, wooden poles or trees set up to worship the goddess Asherah (meaning m3); it replaces the "अशेरा-स्तंभ" of Exodus and Deuteronomy for Kings, so a reviewer may want the two harmonised.

decisions.choice: "महानद" (L); "फ़रात नदी" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The River is the Euphrates; Literal keeps "महानद" as 2 Samuel 10:16 in this translation, Balanced and Readable name it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "столбы Ашеры" (L, B); "деревянные столбы для поклонения богине Ашере" (R)
decisions.reason: The history terms note's term, worded as Deuteronomy 7:5 and 16:21 have it in Russian at each level.

decisions.choice: "за Рекой" (L); "за рекой Евфрат" (B); "по ту сторону реки Евфрат" (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 8:3 and 10:16 in Russian: "Река" at Literal, the Euphrates named at the other levels.

decisions.choice: "Он вырвет" at the start of a sentence, plain
decisions.reason: A pronoun that starts a sentence is written with its capital and no span, as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: asherim "アシェラ像" (L, B), "女神アシェラを拝むための木の柱" (R)
decisions.reason: As EXO 34:13, DEU 7:5 and JDG 6:25.

decisions.choice: hannahar "川" (L), "ユーフラテス川" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The River is the Euphrates, as the English Balanced and Readable say (GEN 31, NUM 22).

decisions.choice: "ашери" (L), "стовпи Ашери" (B), "стовпи для поклоніння Ашері" (R); "Ріка" at L for the Euphrates, named at B and R
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes wooden poles or trees for the goddess; Literal keeps the Hebrew word as a common noun, and the other levels say what the object was.

source.text: וְיִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּגְלַ֞ל חַטֹּ֤אות יָֽרָבְעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will give up Israel on account of [the] sins of Jeroboam which he sinned and which he made sin Israel.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give up Israel on account of the sins of Jeroboam, which he sinned and which he made Israel sin."
en.B: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he committed and by which he led Israel to sin."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will abandon Israel because of the sins of Jeroboam. Jeroboam sinned, and he led Israel into sin as well."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entregará a Israel a causa de los pecados de Jeroboam, con que pecó y con que hizo pecar a Israel».
es.B: Entregará a Israel por causa de los pecados de Jeroboam, los que él cometió y los que hizo cometer a Israel».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} abandonará a Israel por causa de los pecados de Jeroboam. Jeroboam pecó, y también hizo pecar a Israel».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} livrera Israël à cause des péchés de Jéroboam, qu’il a commis et qu’il a fait commettre à Israël. »
fr.B: Il abandonnera Israël à cause des péchés de Jéroboam, qu’il a commis et qu’il a fait commettre à Israël. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} abandonnera Israël à cause des péchés de Jéroboam. Jéroboam a péché, et il a aussi entraîné Israël dans le péché. »

sw.L: Naye atamwacha Israeli kwa ajili ya dhambi za Yeroboamu, alizotenda na alizowafanya Israeli kutenda."
sw.B: Atamwacha Israeli kwa sababu ya dhambi za Yeroboamu, alizozitenda na ambazo kwa hizo aliwaongoza Israeli kutenda dhambi."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaacha Israeli kwa sababu ya dhambi za Yeroboamu. Yeroboamu alitenda dhambi, akawaongoza Israeli nao kutenda dhambi."

vi.L: Ngài sẽ phó Y-sơ-ra-ên vì các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am, là tội ông đã phạm và tội ông đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm."
vi.B: Ngài sẽ bỏ mặc Y-sơ-ra-ên vì các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am, là tội ông đã phạm và đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm theo."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ từ bỏ Y-sơ-ra-ên vì các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am. Giê-rô-bô-am đã phạm tội, và ông cũng khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm tội."

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 여로보암이 지은 죄와 그가 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄 때문에 이스라엘을 내주실 것이오."
ko.B: 그분께서는 여로보암이 지은 죄와 그가 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄 때문에 이스라엘을 버리실 것이오."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 여로보암의 죄 때문에 이스라엘을 버리실 것이오. 여로보암은 자기도 죄를 짓고 이스라엘도 죄를 짓게 했소."

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entregará Israel por causa dos pecados de Jeroboão, que ele pecou e com os quais fez Israel pecar."
pt.B: Ele abandonará Israel por causa dos pecados de Jeroboão, os pecados que ele cometeu e com os quais fez Israel pecar."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai abandonar Israel por causa dos pecados de Jeroboão. Jeroboão pecou e levou Israel a pecar também."

am.L: ኢዮርብዓም ስለ ሠራውና እስራኤልን ስላሳተበት ስለ ኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት እስራኤልን አሳልፎ ይሰጣል።»
am.B: ኢዮርብዓም ስለ ሠራውና እስራኤልም እንዲሠሩ ስላደረገበት ኃጢአት እስራኤልን አሳልፎ ይሰጣል።»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስለ ኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት እስራኤልን ይተዋል። ኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት ሠራ፤ እስራኤልንም ወደ ኃጢአት መራ።»

hi.L: और वे यारोबाम के उन पापों के कारण इस्राएल को त्याग देंगे जो उसने स्वयं किए और जिनसे उसने इस्राएल से पाप करवाया।"
hi.B: वे यारोबाम के उन पापों के कारण इस्राएल को त्याग देंगे जो उसने किए और जिनके द्वारा उसने इस्राएल से पाप करवाया।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} इस्राएल को छोड़ देंगे, यारोबाम के पापों के कारण। यारोबाम ने स्वयं पाप किया, और उसने इस्राएल से भी पाप करवाया।"

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} предаст Израиль за грехи Иеровоама, которыми он согрешил и которыми ввёл в грех Израиль.»
ru.B: Он оставит Израиль из-за грехов Иеровоама, которые тот совершил и которыми ввёл в грех Израиль.»
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} оставит Израиль из-за грехов Иеровоама. Иеровоам согрешил сам и ввёл в грех Израиль.»

ja.L: そして、ヤロブアムが犯した罪、また彼がイスラエルに犯させた罪のゆえに、イスラエルを引き渡される。」
ja.B: また、ヤロブアムが犯した罪、彼がイスラエルに犯させた罪のために、イスラエルを見捨てられる。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はイスラエルを見捨てられる。ヤロブアムの罪のためである。ヤロブアムは自分が罪を犯しただけでなく、イスラエルの人々にも罪を犯させたのだ。」

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} віддасть Ізраїль за гріхи Єровоама, якими він згрішив і якими він довів Ізраїль до гріха».
uk.B: Він віддасть Ізраїль через гріхи Єровоама, які той учинив і якими ввів Ізраїль у гріх».
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} покине Ізраїль через гріхи Єровоама. Єровоам згрішив і ввів у гріх також Ізраїль».

decisions.choice: he will give up Israel: Yahweh will hand Israel over to its enemies
decisions.reason: The verb "give" here means to give up, abandon, hand over. Yahweh will no longer protect the people.

decisions.choice: the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned and which he made Israel sin
decisions.reason: This phrase becomes the refrain of Kings for every northern king (15:26, 30, 34; 16:26; 2 Kings 17:21-22). Jeroboam's sin was not only his own: he led the whole nation into false worship at Bethel and Dan (12:30).

decisions.choice: The LORD will abandon Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names Yahweh as the subject, which the Hebrew verb leaves to be understood. The double quote mark closes Ahijah's speech, opened in verse 6.

decisions.choice: made Israel sin (Literal); led Israel to sin (Balanced); led Israel into sin (Readable)
decisions.reason: This phrase is said of nearly every king of Israel after Jeroboam (m2), and each level keeps one wording for it throughout Kings: "made Israel sin" at Literal, "led Israel to sin" at Balanced, "led Israel into sin" at Readable. Later uses refer back here.

decisions.choice: "con que hizo pecar a Israel" (L); "los que hizo cometer a Israel" (B)
decisions.reason: The sin of Jeroboam in the Kings and Chronicles note's wording for each level, which recurs through the books.

decisions.choice: "qu’il a fait commettre à Israël" (L, B); "entraîné Israël dans le péché" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for the sin of Jeroboam, following the Kings and Chronicles terms note, used for every later king of Israel.

decisions.choice: alizowafanya Israeli kutenda (Literal); aliwaongoza Israeli kutenda dhambi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The phrase that becomes the refrain of Kings, "the sins he made Israel sin", is "dhambi ... aliyowafanya Israeli kutenda" at Literal and in the regnal formula, and "kuwaongoza Israeli kutenda dhambi" where Balanced and Readable loosen it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tội ông đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the sin of Jeroboam, kept each time it returns in Kings.

decisions.choice: "그가 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the sin of Jeroboam, which recurs in every verdict on the kings of Israel; it is held through the block.

decisions.choice: que ele pecou e com os quais fez Israel pecar (L); que ele cometeu e com os quais fez Israel pecar (B); pecou e levou Israel a pecar também (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the refrain on every northern king (m2; 15:26, 30, 34; 16:26) keeps one wording at each level, "com os quais fez Israel pecar" at Literal and Balanced, the causative "fazer pecar" that answers the Hebrew verb, and "levou Israel a pecar" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "ኢዮርብዓም የሠራውና እስራኤልን ያሳተበት ኃጢአት" (Literal); "... እስራኤልም እንዲሠሩ ያደረገበት ኃጢአት" (Balanced); "ኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት ሠራ፤ እስራኤልንም ወደ ኃጢአት መራ" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The formula returns for every king of Israel (15:26, 30, 34; 16:2, 19, 26, 31); one wording at each level. "ያሳተ" (led astray) gives the causative "made sin" in one Amharic verb.

decisions.choice: "यारोबाम के ... पाप ... जिनसे उसने इस्राएल से पाप करवाया"
decisions.reason: The phrase that will mark every northern king (meaning m2); Hindi "पाप करवाना" says "made Israel sin" in one verb, kept the same at every level and through Kings.

decisions.choice: "которыми согрешил и которыми ввёл в грех Израиль"
decisions.reason: The refrain on Jeroboam's sin, worded once here and kept at each level whenever it recurs (15:26, 15:30, 15:34; 16:2, 16:13, 16:19, 16:26).

decisions.choice: "ヤロブアムが犯した罪、また彼がイスラエルに犯させた罪" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The refrain on Jeroboam's sins, kept in the same words wherever it returns (15:26, 15:30, 15:34, 16:2, 16:26).

decisions.choice: Readable names the subject as {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}
decisions.reason: As the English Readable.

source.text: וַתָּ֨קָם֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ וַתָּבֹ֣א תִרְצָ֑תָה הִ֛יא בָּאָ֥ה בְסַף־הַבַּ֖יִת וְהַנַּ֥עַר מֵֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And arose [the] wife of Jeroboam and went and came to Tirzah; she [was] coming in the threshold of the house, and the boy died.

en.L: And the wife of Jeroboam arose and went and came to Tirzah. She [was] coming to the threshold of the house, and the boy died.
en.B: Then Jeroboam's wife got up and left and came to Tirzah. As she was stepping over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
en.R: Jeroboam's wife got up and went back home to Tirzah. Just as she stepped through the doorway of the house, the boy died.

es.L: Y se levantó la mujer de Jeroboam y se fue y llegó a Tirsa. Ella [estaba] llegando al umbral de la casa, y el muchacho murió.
es.B: Entonces la mujer de Jeroboam se levantó, se fue y llegó a Tirsa. Cuando cruzaba el umbral de la casa, el muchacho murió.
es.R: La esposa de Jeroboam se levantó y volvió a su casa en Tirsa. Justo cuando entraba por la puerta de la casa, el muchacho murió.

fr.L: Et la femme de Jéroboam se leva, s’en alla et arriva à Tirtsa. Elle entrait sur le seuil de la maison, et le garçon mourut.
fr.B: La femme de Jéroboam se leva, partit et arriva à Tirtsa. Comme elle franchissait le seuil de la maison, le garçon mourut.
fr.R: La femme de Jéroboam s’est levée et elle est rentrée chez elle à Tirtsa. Au moment même où elle passait la porte de la maison, le garçon est mort.

sw.L: Mke wa Yeroboamu akainuka akaenda, akafika Tirza. Alipokuwa akiingia kizingiti cha nyumba, kijana akafa.
sw.B: Kisha mke wa Yeroboamu akaondoka, akaenda, akafika Tirza. Alipokuwa akivuka kizingiti cha nyumba, kijana akafa.
sw.R: Mke wa Yeroboamu akaondoka akarudi nyumbani Tirza. Mara alipoingia mlangoni mwa nyumba, mvulana akafa.

vi.L: Vợ của Giê-rô-bô-am đứng dậy ra đi và đến Tiệt-sa. Bà vừa bước đến ngưỡng cửa nhà, thì đứa trẻ chết.
vi.B: Vợ Giê-rô-bô-am đứng dậy ra về và đến Tiệt-sa. Bà vừa bước qua ngưỡng cửa nhà thì đứa trẻ chết.
vi.R: Vợ Giê-rô-bô-am đứng dậy và trở về nhà ở Tiệt-sa. Ngay khi bà bước qua cửa nhà, đứa trẻ chết.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암의 아내가 일어나 가서 디르사에 이르렀다. 그 여자가 집 문지방에 들어설 때에 그 아이가 죽었다.
ko.B: 여로보암의 아내는 일어나 길을 떠나 디르사로 돌아왔다. 그 여자가 집 문지방을 넘어서는 순간 그 아이가 죽었다.
ko.R: 여로보암의 아내는 일어나 디르사에 있는 집으로 돌아갔다. 그 여자가 집 문간에 들어서는 바로 그때 아이가 죽었다.

pt.L: E a mulher de Jeroboão se levantou, e foi, e chegou a Tirza. Ela [estava] chegando à soleira da casa, e o menino morreu.
pt.B: Então a mulher de Jeroboão se levantou, partiu e chegou a Tirza. Quando ela estava passando pela soleira da casa, o menino morreu.
pt.R: A mulher de Jeroboão se levantou e voltou para casa, em Tirza. No momento em que ela passou pela porta da casa, o menino morreu.

am.L: የኢዮርብዓምም ሚስት ተነሥታ ሄደች፤ ወደ ቲርጻም መጣች። በቤቱ መድረክ ስትገባ ብላቴናው ሞተ።
am.B: ከዚያም የኢዮርብዓም ሚስት ተነሥታ ሄደች፤ ወደ ቲርጻም መጣች። የቤቱን መድረክ ስትረግጥ ልጁ ሞተ።
am.R: የኢዮርብዓም ሚስት ተነሥታ ወደ ቤቷ ወደ ቲርጻ ተመለሰች። ልክ የቤቱን ደጃፍ ስትረግጥ ልጁ ሞተ።

hi.L: और यारोबाम की पत्नी उठकर चली गई और तिर्सा में आई; वह घर की डेवढ़ी पर पहुँच [ही रही थी], और लड़का मर गया।
hi.B: तब यारोबाम की पत्नी उठकर चल दी और तिर्सा पहुँची। ज्यों ही उसने घर की डेवढ़ी पर पाँव रखा, लड़का मर गया।
hi.R: यारोबाम की पत्नी उठकर अपने घर तिर्सा लौट गई। जैसे ही उसने घर के दरवाज़े में क़दम रखा, लड़का मर गया।

ru.L: И встала жена Иеровоама, и пошла, и пришла в Фирцу. Она входила на порог дома, и мальчик умер.
ru.B: Тогда жена Иеровоама встала, ушла и пришла в Фирцу. Как только она переступила порог дома, мальчик умер.
ru.R: Жена Иеровоама встала и вернулась домой, в Фирцу. Как только она вошла в дверь дома, мальчик умер.

ja.L: そしてヤロブアムの妻は立って去り、ティルツァに着いた。彼女が家の敷居に来たとき、その子は死んだ。
ja.B: ヤロブアムの妻は立ち上がって去り、ティルツァに帰った。彼女が家の敷居をまたいだとき、その子は死んだ。
ja.R: ヤロブアムの妻は立ち上がり、ティルツァの家に帰りました。そして家の戸口に足を踏み入れたちょうどその時、その子は死にました。

uk.L: І встала жінка Єровоама, і пішла, і прийшла до Тірци. Вона входила на поріг дому, і хлопець помер.
uk.B: Тоді Єровоамова жінка встала, вирушила і прийшла до Тірци. Щойно вона переступила поріг дому, хлопець помер.
uk.R: Єровоамова жінка встала і повернулася додому до Тірци. Щойно вона ступила на поріг дому, хлопець помер.

decisions.choice: Tirzah: the royal city of the northern kingdom at this time
decisions.reason: Jeroboam had first built up Shechem (12:25); by now the king lived at Tirzah, northeast of Shechem. It stayed the capital of the northern kingdom until Omri built Samaria (15:21, 33; 16:23-24).

decisions.choice: she was coming to the threshold, and the boy died: at the very moment
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the two events side by side. The death came exactly as Ahijah had said (verse 12).

decisions.choice: the doorway (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable uses a common word for "threshold".

decisions.choice: "Tirsa"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of Tirzah, kept through Kings.

decisions.choice: "Tirtsa"
decisions.reason: The French spelling with ts for the Hebrew tsade, as Tsiqlag and Mitspa in Samuel; for the whole book.

decisions.choice: "Tiệt-sa"
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant form of Tirzah, kept through Kings.

decisions.choice: Tirza
decisions.reason: For the whole book (15:21, 33; 16:6-23): the royal city (m1) keeps the form "Tirza", as Joshua 12:24 has it in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "ቲርጻ" (Tirzah)
decisions.reason: The town takes the form of Zelophehad's daughter Tirzah in the Amharic Numbers (the same Hebrew name).
The form of Numbers 26:33 and Joshua 12:24 in this translation; here the royal city of the north (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "Фирца"
decisions.reason: As Joshua 12:24 in this translation; the same royal city through chapters 15-16.

decisions.choice: Tirzah "ティルツァ"
decisions.reason: As JOS 12:24.

source.text: וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־ל֖וֹ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּדְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַד־עַבְדּ֖וֹ אֲחִיָּ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And they buried him and mourned for him all Israel, according to [the] word of Yahweh which he spoke by [the] hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

en.L: And they buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke by the hand of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} slave Ahijah the prophet.
en.B: They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Ahijah the prophet.
en.R: The people buried him, and everyone in Israel mourned for him. This happened just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, the prophet Ahijah.

es.L: Y lo sepultaron, y todo Israel hizo duelo por él, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Ahías el profeta.
es.B: Lo sepultaron, y todo Israel hizo duelo por él, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había dicho por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Ahías el profeta.
es.R: La gente lo sepultó, y todos en Israel hicieron duelo por él. Esto sucedió tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había dicho por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, el profeta Ahías.

fr.L: Et on l’enterra, et tout Israël se lamenta sur lui, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite par la main de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Ahiya le prophète.
fr.B: On l’enterra, et tout Israël le pleura, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Ahiya, le prophète.
fr.R: On l’a enterré, et tout le monde en Israël l’a pleuré. C’est arrivé exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, le prophète Ahiya.

sw.L: Wakamzika, na Israeli wote wakamwombolezea, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilolisema kwa mkono wa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Ahiya nabii.
sw.B: Wakamzika, na Israeli wote wakamwombolezea, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema kupitia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Ahiya nabii.
sw.R: Watu wakamzika, na kila mtu katika Israeli akamwombolezea. Hili lilitokea kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema kupitia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, nabii Ahiya.
