vi.L: Họ chôn nó, và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên than khóc nó, đúng theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán qua tay đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là nhà tiên tri A-hi-gia.
vi.B: Họ chôn cất nó, và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên than khóc nó, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là nhà tiên tri A-hi-gia.
vi.R: Dân chúng chôn cất nó, và mọi người trong Y-sơ-ra-ên than khóc nó. Việc ấy xảy ra đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là nhà tiên tri A-hi-gia.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그를 묻었고, 온 이스라엘이 그를 위해 슬퍼했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀, 곧 그분께서 그분의 종 예언자 아히야의 손을 통해 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.B: 그들은 그를 묻었고, 온 이스라엘이 그를 위해 슬퍼했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종 예언자 아히야를 통해 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.R: 사람들은 그를 묻었고, 이스라엘의 모든 사람이 그를 위해 슬퍼했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 종인 예언자 아히야를 통해 말씀하신 그대로 일어났다.

pt.L: E o sepultaram, e todo o Israel chorou por ele, segundo a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou pela mão do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} escravo Aías, o profeta.
pt.B: Eles o sepultaram, e todo o Israel chorou por ele, conforme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito por meio do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo, o profeta Aías.
pt.R: O povo o sepultou, e todos em Israel choraram por ele. Isso aconteceu exatamente como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito por meio do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} servo, o profeta Aías.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በባሪያው በነቢዩ በአኪያ እጅ እንደ ተናገረው ቃል ቀበሩት፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ አለቀሱለት።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በአገልጋዩ በነቢዩ በአኪያ በኩል እንደ ተናገረው ቀበሩት፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ አለቀሱለት።
am.R: ሕዝቡ ቀበሩት፤ በእስራኤልም ያለ ሁሉ አለቀሰለት። ይህም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በአገልጋዩ በነቢዩ በአኪያ በኩል እንደ ተናገረው ሆነ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने उसे मिट्टी दी, और सारे इस्राएल ने उसके लिए विलाप किया, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के उस वचन के अनुसार जो उन्होंने अपने दास अहिय्याह भविष्यद्वक्ता के हाथ से कहा था।
hi.B: उन्होंने उसे मिट्टी दी, और सारे इस्राएल ने उसके लिए विलाप किया, ठीक जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने दास अहिय्याह भविष्यद्वक्ता के द्वारा कहा था।
hi.R: लोगों ने उसे दफ़नाया, और इस्राएल में सब ने उसके लिए शोक मनाया। यह ठीक वैसा ही हुआ जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने दास, अहिय्याह नबी, के द्वारा कहा था।

ru.L: И похоронили его, и оплакал его весь Израиль, по слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал через своего раба Ахию, пророка.
ru.B: Его похоронили, и весь Израиль оплакал его, как и сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} через своего раба, пророка Ахию.
ru.R: Люди похоронили его, и весь Израиль оплакивал его. Всё случилось так, как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал через своего раба, пророка Ахию.

ja.L: そして人々は彼を葬り、全イスラエルは彼のために嘆いた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がその奴隷、預言者アヒヤの手によって語られた言葉のとおりであった。
ja.B: 人々は彼を葬り、全イスラエルは彼のために嘆き悲しんだ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がそのしもべ、預言者アヒヤを通して語られたとおりであった。
ja.R: 人々はその子を葬り、イスラエルの人々はみな、その子のために泣き悲しみました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、ご自分のしもべである預言者アヒヤを通して言われたとおりになったのです。

uk.L: І поховали його, і оплакував його весь Ізраїль, за словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, яке {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав через свого раба Ахію, пророка.
uk.B: Його поховали, і весь Ізраїль оплакував його, як і сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} через свого слугу Ахію, пророка.
uk.R: Люди поховали його, і всі в Ізраїлі оплакували його. Сталося так, як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав через свого слугу, пророка Ахію.

decisions.choice: according to the word of Yahweh: the first part of the prophecy comes true
decisions.reason: Kings often notes that a prophet's word was fulfilled (12:15; 15:29; 16:12, 34). The boy's death and burial happen as Ahijah said (verses 12-13); the rest waits for 15:29.

decisions.choice: by the hand of: through, by means of
decisions.reason: Yahweh speaks through his prophet as an agent: the "hand" is the one who carries out the act.

decisions.choice: his slave Ahijah (Literal); his servant Ahijah (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The rule for this word when used of Yahweh's prophets, as with "my servant David" (verse 8).

decisions.choice: "su siervo Ahías" at every level
decisions.reason: God's servant the prophet is "siervo" at every level, as the Samuel note sets for "my servant David"; the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: "son serviteur Ahiya" at every level
decisions.reason: As for "my servant David": a servant of God named by God’s word is "serviteur" at every level in French.

decisions.choice: mtumishi wake (Literal)
decisions.reason: A named servant of God is "mtumishi" at every level in Swahili, as the Psalms note sets, where the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: segundo a palavra do SENHOR (L); conforme o SENHOR tinha dito (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the note of a prophecy fulfilled (m1; 15:29; 16:12, 34) is "segundo a palavra do SENHOR" at Literal and "conforme o SENHOR tinha dito" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "अपने दास अहिय्याह" at every level
decisions.reason: As "my servant David" in this translation, "दास" at every level for the prophet as Yahweh's servant.

decisions.choice: "своего раба" without a span
decisions.reason: With the LORD as the subject Russian uses the reflexive "своего", which takes no deity_pronoun span; "раб" at every level, as for David.

decisions.choice: beyad "…の手によって" (L), "…を通して" (B, R)
decisions.reason: By means of; Literal keeps the Hebrew picture.

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִלְחַ֖ם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלָ֑ךְ הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold they [are] written in [the] book of [the] matters of the days of the kings of Israel.

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, look, they [are] written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel.
en.B: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Jeroboam did, the wars he fought and the way he ruled, is written in the history of the kings of Israel.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Jeroboam, cómo peleó y cómo reinó, he aquí que [están] escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel.
es.B: Los demás hechos de Jeroboam, cómo hizo la guerra y cómo reinó, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Jeroboam, las guerras que hizo y la manera en que gobernó, está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Jéroboam, comment il fit la guerre et comment il régna, voici, ils [sont] écrits dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Jéroboam, ses guerres et son règne, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout ce que Jéroboam a fait d’autre, les guerres qu’il a faites et sa façon de gouverner, a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yeroboamu, jinsi alivyopigana na jinsi alivyotawala, tazama, [yameandikwa] katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yeroboamu, jinsi alivyopigana vita na jinsi alivyotawala, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyofanya Yeroboamu, vita alivyopigana na jinsi alivyotawala, yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giê-rô-bô-am, thể nào ông đã chiến đấu và thể nào ông đã trị vì, kìa, đều được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giê-rô-bô-am, những trận ông đã đánh và cách ông trị vì, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Giê-rô-bô-am đã làm, những trận chiến ông đã đánh và cách ông cai trị, đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암의 나머지 일들, 곧 그가 어떻게 싸웠고 어떻게 다스렸는지는, 보라, 이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일들을 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.
ko.B: 여로보암의 나머지 행적, 곧 그가 어떻게 싸웠고 어떻게 다스렸는지는 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 여로보암이 한 다른 모든 일, 곧 그가 치른 전쟁과 그가 나라를 다스린 일은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Jeroboão, como guerreou e como reinou, eis que estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel.
pt.B: Os demais atos de Jeroboão, como ele guerreou e como reinou, estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Jeroboão fez, as guerras que ele lutou e o jeito como governou, está escrito na história dos reis de Israel.

am.L: የቀረውም የኢዮርብዓም ሥራ፣ እንዴት እንደ ተዋጋና እንዴት እንደ ነገሠ፣ እነሆ፣ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፏል።
am.B: የቀረው የኢዮርብዓም ሥራ፣ እንዴት እንደ ተዋጋና እንዴት እንደ ነገሠ፣ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፏል።
am.R: ኢዮርብዓም ያደረገው ሌላው ነገር ሁሉ፣ ያደረጋቸው ጦርነቶችና የአገዛዙ ሁኔታ፣ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ ተጽፏል።

hi.L: और यारोबाम की बाक़ी बातें, कि उसने कैसे युद्ध किया और कैसे राज्य किया, देखो, वे इस्राएल के राजाओं के इतिहास की पुस्तक में लिखी हैं।
hi.B: यारोबाम के बाक़ी काम, कि उसने कैसे युद्ध किए और कैसे राज्य किया, इस्राएल के राजाओं के इतिहास की पुस्तक में लिखे हैं।
hi.R: यारोबाम ने जो कुछ और किया, जो युद्ध उसने लड़े और जिस तरह उसने राज्य किया, वह सब इस्राएल के राजाओं के इतिहास में लिखा है।

ru.L: А прочие дела Иеровоама, как он воевал и как царствовал, — вот, это записано в книге летописи царей Израиля.
ru.B: Прочие дела Иеровоама, как он воевал и как царствовал, записаны в книге летописи царей Израиля.
ru.R: Обо всём остальном, что сделал Иеровоам, о войнах, которые он вёл, и о том, как он правил, написано в летописи царей Израиля.

ja.L: ヤロブアムのその他の事績、彼がどのように戦い、どのように治めたかは、イスラエルの王たちの年代記の書に記されているではないか？
ja.B: ヤロブアムのその他の事績、彼がどのように戦い、どのように治めたかは、イスラエルの王の年代記に記されている。
ja.R: ヤロブアムがしたほかのこと、つまり、彼がした戦いや、国の治め方は、イスラエルの王たちの記録に書かれています。

uk.L: А решта справ Єровоама, як він воював і як царював, — ось вони записані в книзі хронік царів Ізраїлю.
uk.B: Решта діянь Єровоама, як він воював і як царював, записані в книзі хронік царів Ізраїлю.
uk.R: Усе інше, що зробив Єровоам, війни, які він вів, і те, як він правив, записано в історії царів Ізраїлю.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel: a royal record, now lost
decisions.reason: This was an official record of the northern kingdom, a kind of court chronicle, which the writer of Kings used and pointed readers to. It is not the biblical book of Chronicles. Kings cites a "book of the acts of Solomon" (11:41) and, for the southern kingdom, a book of the kings of Judah (verse 29). None of these books has survived.

decisions.choice: the matters of Jeroboam: his deeds and the events of his reign
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means words, matters or affairs. In this formula it means what the king did and what happened in his reign.

decisions.choice: how he fought: wars not told here
decisions.reason: Kings mentions war between Jeroboam and Rehoboam (verse 30) and with Abijam (15:7), but gives no details. 2 Chronicles 13:2-20 tells of one battle.

decisions.choice: the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel (Balanced); the history of the kings of Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this source formula throughout Kings, opening with "The rest of the acts of" at Balanced and "Everything else ... did" at Readable. Here the Hebrew says "look, they are written" rather than asking "Are they not written?" (verse 29); Balanced and Readable state both as plain statements.

decisions.choice: "el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel" (L); "el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel" (B); "la historia de los reyes de Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: The source formula as the Kings and Chronicles note sets for Spanish, kept apart from the Spanish title of Chronicles; here the Hebrew says "look, they are written" rather than asking, so Literal keeps the statement.

decisions.choice: "le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël"
alternatives: "le livre des Chroniques des rois d’Israël"
"le livre de l’histoire des rois d’Israël"
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note: "Annales" keeps the royal record apart from the French title of the books of Chronicles ("Chroniques"). One wording for the whole block, with "Juda" for the southern record.

decisions.choice: kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli (Literal); Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli (Balanced); historia ya wafalme wa Israeli (Readable)
decisions.reason: The royal record is named so that it is not confused with the book of Chronicles ("Mambo ya Nyakati"), as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua" (L); "Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B); "sách lịch sử các vua" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the source book; "Sử Ký" is the Vietnamese title of Chronicles and is avoided so the two are not confused. Literal spells out "the book of the matters of the days".

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일들을 적은 책" (L), "이스라엘 왕 실록" (B), "이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's names for the lost royal record. "역대기" and "역대지" are avoided because they are the Korean titles of the books of Chronicles; Literal keeps the Hebrew "book of the matters of the days". The Readable wording is marked uncertain in the terms note.

decisions.choice: o restante dos atos de ... (L); Os demais atos de ... (B); Tudo o mais que ... fez (R); o livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel (L), o Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel (B), a história dos reis de Israel (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the source note keeps one wording at each level. "Crônicas" says "the matters of the days" (m1), the court record of each king's reign; it is a lost royal record, not the biblical book of Chronicles, which takes its Portuguese name from the same Hebrew phrase. Balanced writes it as a title, Readable as "a história dos reis".

decisions.choice: "የቀረውም የX ሥራ ... በእስራኤል ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ" (Literal, Balanced); "X ያደረገው ሌላው ነገር ሁሉ ... በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ ተጽፏል" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The closing formula as the terms list for Kings sets it, used for every king in 1 Kings 14-16. Here the Hebrew says "look, they are written" rather than asking, so Literal has "እነሆ" and no question.

decisions.choice: "इस्राएल के राजाओं के इतिहास की पुस्तक" (L, B); "इस्राएल के राजाओं का इतिहास" (R)
decisions.reason: The source formula of the history-books note, the same through Kings; a royal record, now lost (meaning m1). Here the Hebrew says "look, they are written", not a question, and Literal follows it.

decisions.choice: "в книге летописи царей Израиля" (L, B); "в летописи царей Израиля" (R)
decisions.reason: The source formula of the history terms note; here the Hebrew says "look, they are written", so Literal has "вот, это записано" in place of the question.

decisions.choice: sefer divrei hayyamim lemalkhei Yisra'el "イスラエルの王たちの年代記の書" (L), "イスラエルの王の年代記" (B), "イスラエルの王たちの記録" (R); yeter divrei X "Xのその他の事績" (L, B), "Xがしたほかのこと" (R)
decisions.reason: The closing formula of each reign, as fixed for Kings in 1KI 11:41 (Judah: ユダの王…). The book title is not put in brackets, which mark speech; 歴代誌 is avoided because it is the name of the biblical book Chronicles.

decisions.choice: hinnam ketuvim "…に記されているではないか？" (L), the same words as halo' hem ketuvim (11:41, 14:29)
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps one wording in every reign of 1-2 Kings (1KI-3 notes); the question that expects yes carries the pointing force of "look" without 見よ.

decisions.choice: "книга хронік царів Ізраїлю / Юдеї" (L, B), lowercase, as the terms note gives it; "історія царів Ізраїлю" (R); the question «Хіба це не записано...?» at L where the Hebrew asks, a statement at B and R
alternatives: "Книга історії царів Ізраїлю" at B, as the English Balanced
decisions.reason: The terms note fixes the L wording; lowercase "книга хронік" keeps the lost royal record apart from the biblical book title "Хроніки". Here the Hebrew itself is a statement ("look, they are written"), so L is one too.

source.text: וְהַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלַ֣ךְ יָרָבְעָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁכַּב֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ נָדָ֥ב בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And the days which reigned Jeroboam [were] twenty and two years; and he lay down with his fathers, and reigned Nadab his son in his place.

en.L: And the days that Jeroboam reigned [were] twenty-two years; and he lay down with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Jeroboam reigned twenty-two years. Then he rested with his ancestors, and his son Nadab became king in his place.
en.R: Jeroboam ruled as king for twenty-two years. Then he died, and his son Nadab became king after him.

es.L: Y los días que reinó Jeroboam [fueron] veintidós años; y durmió con sus padres, y reinó en su lugar Nadab su hijo.
es.B: Jeroboam reinó veintidós años. Luego descansó con sus antepasados, y su hijo Nadab reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Jeroboam gobernó como rey durante veintidós años. Luego murió, y su hijo Nadab lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et les jours que Jéroboam régna [furent de] vingt-deux ans ; et il se coucha avec ses pères, et Nadab son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Jéroboam régna vingt-deux ans. Puis il reposa avec ses ancêtres, et Nadab son fils régna à sa place.
fr.R: Jéroboam a été roi pendant vingt-deux ans. Ensuite il est mort, et son fils Nadab est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Siku alizotawala Yeroboamu [zilikuwa] miaka ishirini na miwili; akalala pamoja na baba zake, na Nadabu mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Yeroboamu alitawala miaka ishirini na miwili. Kisha akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, na mwanawe Nadabu akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Yeroboamu alitawala kama mfalme kwa miaka ishirini na miwili. Kisha akafa, na mwanawe Nadabu akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Những ngày Giê-rô-bô-am trị vì [là] hai mươi hai năm; rồi ông nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và Na-đáp con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Giê-rô-bô-am trị vì hai mươi hai năm. Rồi ông an giấc cùng tổ tiên, và Na-đáp con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Giê-rô-bô-am làm vua được hai mươi hai năm. Rồi ông qua đời, và Na-đáp con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암이 다스린 날은 22년이었다. 그리고 그는 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 그의 아들 나답이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 여로보암은 22년 동안 다스렸다. 그는 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 그의 아들 나답이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 여로보암은 22년 동안 왕으로 다스렸다. 그는 죽었고, 그의 아들 나답이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E os dias que Jeroboão reinou [foram] vinte e dois anos; e ele descansou com os seus pais, e Nadabe, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Jeroboão reinou vinte e dois anos. Depois descansou com os seus antepassados, e o seu filho Nadabe reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Jeroboão governou como rei durante vinte e dois anos. Depois ele morreu, e o seu filho Nadabe se tornou rei depois dele.

am.L: ኢዮርብዓምም የነገሠበት ዘመን ሃያ ሁለት ዓመት ነበረ፤ ከአባቶቹም ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ ልጁም ናዳብ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
am.B: ኢዮርብዓም ሃያ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ ከዚያም ሞተ፤ ልጁም ናዳብ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
am.R: ኢዮርብዓም ሃያ ሁለት ዓመት ገዛ። ከዚያም ሞተ፤ ልጁም ናዳብ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

hi.L: और जितने दिन यारोबाम ने राज्य किया, वे बाईस वर्ष [थे]; और वह अपने पूर्वजों के साथ सो गया, और उसका पुत्र नादाब उसके स्थान पर राज्य करने लगा।
hi.B: यारोबाम ने बाईस वर्ष राज्य किया। फिर वह अपने पूर्वजों के साथ सो गया, और उसका पुत्र नादाब उसके स्थान पर राजा बना।
hi.R: यारोबाम ने बाईस वर्ष तक राज्य किया। फिर उसकी मृत्यु हुई, और उसके बाद उसका बेटा नादाब राजा बना।

ru.L: А дней, которые царствовал Иеровоам, [было] двадцать два года; и почил он со своими отцами, и воцарился Надав, его сын, вместо него.
ru.B: Иеровоам царствовал двадцать два года. Потом он почил со своими отцами, и вместо него воцарился его сын Надав.
ru.R: Иеровоам правил как царь двадцать два года. Потом он умер, и царём после него стал его сын Надав.

ja.L: ヤロブアムが王であった日々は、二十二年であった。そして彼は先祖たちと共に眠った。そして彼の子ナダブが彼に代わって王となった。
ja.B: ヤロブアムは二十二年間治めた。ヤロブアムは先祖のもとで眠りについた。そして、彼の子ナダブが代わって王となった。
ja.R: ヤロブアムは二十二年間治めました。ヤロブアムは亡くなりました。そして、ヤロブアムの息子ナダブが、次の王になりました。

uk.L: А днів, що царював Єровоам, [було] двадцять два роки; і ліг він зі своїми батьками, і зацарював Надав, його син, замість нього.
uk.B: Єровоам царював двадцять два роки. Потім він спочив зі своїми батьками, і його син Надав став царем замість нього.
uk.R: Єровоам правив як цар двадцять два роки. Потім він помер, і царем після нього став його син Надав.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The formula Kings uses for the death of a king (2:10; 11:43; verse 31). It speaks of death as lying down to rest and joining those who went before. Here it does not name the burial.

decisions.choice: Nadab his son reigned in his place: the reign that ends the house of Jeroboam
decisions.reason: Nadab reigned two years before Baasha killed him and the whole house of Jeroboam, as Ahijah had said (15:25-30; verse 14).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings (2:10).

decisions.choice: "durmió con sus padres" (L); "descansó con sus antepasados" (B); "murió" (R); successor "reinó en su lugar Nadab su hijo" / "su hijo Nadab reinó en su lugar" / "lo sucedió como rey"
decisions.reason: The death and succession formulas as the Kings and Chronicles note sets for Spanish, one wording per level through all four books.

decisions.choice: "se coucha avec ses pères" (L); "reposa avec ses ancêtres" (B); "est mort" (R)
decisions.reason: The death formula of the Kings and Chronicles terms note, one wording per level for every king.

decisions.choice: akalala pamoja na baba zake (Literal); akapumzika pamoja na babu zake (Balanced); akafa (Readable)
decisions.reason: The death formula has one wording per level through these books, as the terms note sets; the successor is "X mwanawe akatawala mahali pake" (Literal), "mwanawe X akawa mfalme mahali pake" (Balanced, Readable).

decisions.choice: "nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình" (L); "an giấc cùng tổ tiên" (B); "qua đời" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's death formula at each level, used for every king in Kings.

decisions.choice: "Na-đáp con trai ông trị vì thay ông" (L); "Na-đáp con trai vua lên kế vị" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's successor formula at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps the Hebrew "reigned in his place".

decisions.choice: "조상들과 함께 누웠고" (L), "조상들과 함께 잠들었고" (B), "죽었고" (R); "그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다" (L), "뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's death and succession formulas, held for every king in the block.

decisions.choice: regnal years in figures ("22년")
decisions.reason: The years of reign, ages and dates of the regnal formulas are written in figures at every level so that the many numbers of Kings can be compared at a glance; short counts in the story stay in words.

decisions.choice: descansou com os seus pais (L), com os seus antepassados (B), morreu (R); X, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar (L), o seu filho X reinou em seu lugar (B), o seu filho X se tornou rei depois dele (R); Nadabe
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the death formula (m1) is worded as it was set at 1:21 and 2:10, and the succession that follows it keeps one wording at each level. "Nadabe" takes the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant, as Exodus 6:23 writes Aaron's son.

decisions.choice: "ከአባቶቹም ጋር አንቀላፋ" (Literal), "ሞተ" (Balanced, Readable); "ልጁም X በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ" at every level
decisions.reason: The formulas as the terms list for Kings sets them, so that 1 and 2 Kings read alike; "ናዳብ" (Nadab) as the terms list names him.

decisions.choice: "अपने पूर्वजों के साथ सो गया" (L, B); "उसकी मृत्यु हुई" (R)
decisions.reason: The death formula of the history-books note.

decisions.choice: "नादाब"
decisions.reason: The form of Exodus 24:1 in this translation, for the same Hebrew name.

decisions.choice: "Надав"
decisions.reason: As Aaron's son Nadab in Exodus 6:23 in this translation.

decisions.choice: shakhav 'im avotav "先祖たちと共に眠る" (L), "先祖のもとで眠りにつく" (B), "亡くなる" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1KI 1:21 and 2:10, through the regnal formulas of Kings.

decisions.choice: Nadab "ナダブ"
decisions.reason: As Aaron's son Nadab (EXO 6:23), the same Hebrew name.

source.text: וּרְחַבְעָם֙ בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וְאַחַ֣ת שָׁנָה֩ רְחַבְעָ֨ם בְּמָלְכ֜וֹ וּֽשֲׁבַ֨ע עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֣ה׀מָלַ֣ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָ֠עִיר אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָשׂ֨וּם אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹ שָׁם֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָעַמֹּנִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned in Judah; a son of forty and one year[s was] Rehoboam in his reigning, and seventeen year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem, the city which chose Yahweh to put his name there from all [the] tribes of Israel; and [the] name of his mother [was] Naamah the Ammonite.

en.L: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam [was] a son of forty-one years when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name there. And the name of his mother [was] Naamah the Ammonite.
en.B: Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had chosen from among all the tribes of Israel as the place for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.
en.R: Solomon's son Rehoboam was king in Judah. He became king at the age of forty-one, and he ruled for seventeen years in Jerusalem. Out of all the tribes of Israel, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had chosen this city as the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would be worshiped. Rehoboam's mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.

es.L: Y Roboam hijo de Salomón reinó en Judá. Hijo de cuarenta y un años [era] Roboam cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó diecisiete años en Jerusalén, la ciudad que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había escogido de entre todas las tribus de Israel para poner allí {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Y el nombre de su madre [era] Naama la amonita.
es.B: Roboam hijo de Salomón reinó en Judá. Roboam tenía cuarenta y un años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó diecisiete años en Jerusalén, la ciudad que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había escogido de entre todas las tribus de Israel como lugar para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Su madre se llamaba Naama la amonita.
es.R: Roboam, el hijo de Salomón, fue rey en Judá. Tenía cuarenta y un años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó diecisiete años en Jerusalén. De entre todas las tribus de Israel, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había escogido esa ciudad como el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sería adorado. La madre de Roboam se llamaba Naama la amonita.

fr.L: Et Roboam fils de Salomon régna en Juda. Roboam [était] fils de quarante et un ans quand il devint roi, et il régna dix-sept ans à Jérusalem, la ville que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisie parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël pour y mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Et le nom de sa mère [était] Naama l’Ammonite.
fr.B: Roboam, fils de Salomon, régna en Juda. Il avait quarante et un ans quand il devint roi, et il régna dix-sept ans à Jérusalem, la ville que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisie parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël pour y mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Sa mère s’appelait Naama l’Ammonite.
fr.R: Roboam, le fils de Salomon, était roi en Juda. Il avait quarante et un ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné dix-sept ans à Jérusalem. Parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait choisi cette ville comme le lieu où on {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorerait. Sa mère s’appelait Naama l’Ammonite.

sw.L: Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani akatawala katika Yuda. Rehoboamu [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka arobaini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, akatawala miaka kumi na saba huko Yerusalemu, mji ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliuchagua kutoka katika makabila yote ya Israeli ili kuweka jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} huko. Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Naama Mwamoni.
sw.B: Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani alitawala katika Yuda. Rehoboamu alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na saba huko Yerusalemu, mji ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliuchagua kati ya makabila yote ya Israeli kuwa mahali pa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Mama yake aliitwa Naama Mwamoni.
sw.R: Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani alikuwa mfalme katika Yuda. Alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini na mmoja alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na saba huko Yerusalemu. Kati ya makabila yote ya Israeli, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameuchagua mji huu kuwa mahali ambapo angeabudiwa. Mama yake Rehoboamu aliitwa Naama Mwamoni.

vi.L: Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn trị vì tại Giu-đa. Rô-bô-am được bốn mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua, và ông trị vì mười bảy năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, là thành {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên để đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại đó. Tên mẹ ông [là] Na-a-ma, người Am-môn.
vi.B: Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn trị vì tại Giu-đa. Rô-bô-am được bốn mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười bảy năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, là thành {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên để làm nơi đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mẹ vua tên là Na-a-ma, người Am-môn.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn làm vua Giu-đa. Ông được bốn mươi mốt tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười bảy năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn thành này làm nơi người ta thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mẹ vua tên là Na-a-ma, người Am-môn.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암이 유다에서 왕이 되었다. 르호보암은 왕이 될 때 41세였고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 이름을 두시려고 이스라엘 모든 지파 가운데서 택하신 성읍 예루살렘에서 17년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 암몬 사람 나아마였다.
ko.B: 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암은 유다를 다스렸다. 르호보암은 41세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 17년 동안 다스렸다. 예루살렘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신의 이름을 두시려고 이스라엘 모든 지파 가운데서 택하신 성읍이다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 암몬 사람 나아마였다.
ko.R: 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암은 유다의 왕이었다. 그는 41세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 17년 동안 다스렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 이 성읍을 택하시고, 그곳에서 예배를 받기로 하셨다. 르호보암의 어머니의 이름은 암몬 사람 나아마였다.

pt.L: E Roboão, filho de Salomão, reinou em Judá. Roboão [tinha] quarenta e um anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dezessete anos em Jerusalém, a cidade que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha escolhido dentre todas as tribos de Israel para pôr ali o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. E o nome da sua mãe [era] Naamá, a amonita.
pt.B: Roboão, filho de Salomão, reinou em Judá. Roboão tinha quarenta e um anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dezessete anos em Jerusalém, a cidade que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha escolhido dentre todas as tribos de Israel para pôr ali o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. A sua mãe se chamava Naamá, a amonita.
pt.R: Roboão, filho de Salomão, foi rei em Judá. Ele tinha quarenta e um anos quando se tornou rei, e governou dezessete anos em Jerusalém. Dentre todas as tribos de Israel, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha escolhido essa cidade como o lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seria adorado. A mãe de Roboão se chamava Naamá, a amonita.

am.L: የሰሎሞንም ልጅ ሮብዓም በይሁዳ ነገሠ። ሮብዓም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የአርባ አንድ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስሙን በዚያ ያኖር ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ በመረጣት ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ነገሠ። የእናቱም ስም አሞናዊቷ ናዕማ ነበረ።
am.B: የሰሎሞን ልጅ ሮብዓም በይሁዳ ነገሠ። ሮብዓም በነገሠ ጊዜ የአርባ አንድ ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስሙ የሚጠራባት ስፍራ እንድትሆን ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ በመረጣት ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌም አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ነገሠ። የእናቱም ስም አሞናዊቷ ናዕማ ነበረ።
am.R: የሰሎሞን ልጅ ሮብዓም በይሁዳ ነገሠ። እርሱም በአርባ አንድ ዓመቱ ንጉሥ ሆነ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ገዛ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ መካከል የሚመለክባት ስፍራ እንድትሆን ይህችን ከተማ መርጦ ነበር። የሮብዓም የእናቱም ስም አሞናዊቷ ናዕማ ነበረ።

hi.L: और सुलैमान का पुत्र रहबाम यहूदा में राज्य करता था। जब रहबाम राजा बना तब इकतालीस वर्ष का था, और उसने यरूशलेम में, उस नगर में जिसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने इस्राएल के सब गोत्रों में से अपना नाम रखने के लिए चुना था, सत्रह वर्ष राज्य किया; और उसकी माता का नाम नामा था, जो अम्मोनी थी।
hi.B: सुलैमान का पुत्र रहबाम यहूदा में राज्य करता था। जब वह राजा बना तब इकतालीस वर्ष का था, और उसने यरूशलेम में सत्रह वर्ष राज्य किया, उस नगर में जिसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने इस्राएल के सब गोत्रों में से अपने नाम के लिए चुना था। उसकी माता का नाम नामा था, जो अम्मोनी थी।
hi.R: सुलैमान का बेटा रहबाम यहूदा का राजा था। जब वह राजा बना तब इकतालीस वर्ष का था, और उसने यरूशलेम में सत्रह वर्ष राज्य किया। इस्राएल के सब गोत्रों में से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने इसी नगर को चुना था कि वहाँ उनकी आराधना हो। उसकी माता का नाम नामा था, जो अम्मोनी थी।

ru.L: А Ровоам, сын Соломона, царствовал в Иуде. Ему было сорок один год, когда он воцарился, и семнадцать лет он царствовал в Иерусалиме, городе, который {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} избрал из всех колен Израиля, чтобы положить там своё имя; имя его матери — Наама аммонитянка.
ru.B: Ровоам, сын Соломона, царствовал в Иуде. Ему было сорок один год, когда он воцарился, и семнадцать лет он царствовал в Иерусалиме — городе, который {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} избрал из всех колен Израиля, чтобы там было {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя. Имя его матери — Наама аммонитянка.
ru.R: Сын Соломона Ровоам был царём в Иуде. Он стал царём в сорок один год и правил семнадцать лет в Иерусалиме. Из всех племён Израиля {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} избрал этот город как место, где будут поклоняться {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. Мать Ровоама звали Наама, она была аммонитянкой.

ja.L: そしてソロモンの子レハブアムはユダで王となった。レハブアムは王となったとき四十一歳で、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の名を置くためにイスラエルの全部族の中から選ばれた町、エルサレムで十七年治めた。彼の母の名はアンモン人ナアマであった。
ja.B: ソロモンの子レハブアムはユダで王となった。レハブアムは王となったとき四十一歳で、エルサレムで十七年間治めた。エルサレムは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の名を置くために、イスラエルの全部族の中から選ばれた町である。母の名はナアマといい、アンモン人であった。
ja.R: ソロモンの息子レハブアムは、ユダの王でした。レハブアムは四十一歳で王になり、エルサレムで十七年間治めました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、イスラエルの全部族の土地の中からこの町を選んで、ご自分が礼拝される場所とされていました。レハブアムの母は、アンモン人のナアマという人でした。

uk.L: А Ровоам, син Соломона, царював в Юдеї. Ровоамові було сорок один рік, коли він зацарював, і сімнадцять років він царював в Єрусалимі, місті, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вибрав з усіх племен Ізраїля, щоб покласти там своє імʼя; а імʼя його матері — Наама аммонітянка.
uk.B: Ровоам, син Соломона, царював в Юдеї. Ровоамові було сорок один рік, коли він зацарював, і сімнадцять років він царював в Єрусалимі, місті, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вибрав з-поміж усіх племен Ізраїля як місце для свого імені. Імʼя його матері — Наама аммонітянка.
uk.R: Соломонів син Ровоам був царем в Юдеї. Він став царем у сорок один рік і правив сімнадцять років в Єрусалимі. З усіх племен Ізраїля {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вибрав це місто як місце, де {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} мали поклонятися. Матір Ровоама звали Наама аммонітянка.

decisions.choice: the opening formula for a king of Judah
decisions.reason: From here on Kings opens each reign with a set pattern. For the kings of Judah it gives the king's age when he became king, the length of his reign, the city where he reigned and his mother's name, and then a verdict on his reign (verse 22). Rehoboam's reign was first told in chapter 12; this formula returns to it after the story of Jeroboam.

decisions.choice: his mother was Naamah the Ammonite: the queen mother
decisions.reason: The kings of Judah are listed with their mothers, who held a place of honor at court (2:19; 15:13). Naamah came from Ammon, east of the Jordan. Since Rehoboam was forty-one when Solomon died after a forty-year reign (11:42), she was married to Solomon before he became king. She is one of the foreign wives of 11:1, and the next verses show Judah following foreign ways of worship.

decisions.choice: the city that Yahweh had chosen to put his name there: Jerusalem, the place of the temple
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy speaks of the one place Yahweh would choose to put his name (Deuteronomy 12:5, 11), and Kings names Jerusalem as that place (8:16, 29; 11:13, 36). The reminder sets Judah's worship at the chosen city against the high places described next.

decisions.choice: a son of forty-one years: forty-one years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years (2 Samuel 5:4).

decisions.choice: Rehoboam ... was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the accession formula throughout Kings. Readable states the meaning of "to put his name there" (m3) as the place where Yahweh would be worshiped.

decisions.choice: "Hijo de cuarenta y un años [era] ... cuando comenzó a reinar" (L); "Tenía N años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó N años en Jerusalén" (B, R); "Su madre se llamaba ..."
decisions.reason: The accession formula for Judah and the mother's name as the Kings and Chronicles note sets; Literal keeps "hijo de N años", as the Spanish of 2 Samuel 5:4 does.

decisions.choice: "Naama la amonita"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of Naamah, with the gentilic "amonita" of the Samuel note.

decisions.choice: "[était] fils de N ans" (L); "Il avait N ans quand il devint roi, et il régna N ans à Jérusalem" (B; R in the passé composé); "Le nom de sa mère [était]" (L), "Sa mère s’appelait" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The accession formula and the mother’s name worded as the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets them, the same for every king of Judah in this block.

decisions.choice: [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka N alipoanza kutawala (Literal); alikuwa na umri wa miaka N alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka N huko Yerusalemu (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The accession formula for the kings of Judah, with "Mama yake aliitwa ..." for the queen mother, keeps one wording per level through these books, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "X được N tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì N năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem"; "Mẹ vua tên là ..."
decisions.reason: The terms note's accession formula for the kings of Judah and its wording for the queen mother, used for every king in Kings; Literal keeps "Tên mẹ ông [là]".

decisions.choice: "41세에 왕이 되어 ... 17년 동안 다스렸다"; "그의 어머니의 이름은 ...였다"
decisions.reason: The terms note's accession formula for the kings of Judah. Literal says "왕이 될 때 41세였고": the Hebrew "a son of forty-one years" is its idiom for age and is explained in the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: [tinha] N anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou N anos em Jerusalém; E o nome da sua mãe [era] (L); tinha N anos quando começou a reinar ... A sua mãe se chamava (B); tinha N anos quando se tornou rei, e governou N anos ... A mãe de X se chamava (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the opening formula of a king of Judah (m1) keeps one wording at each level, that of 2 Samuel 2:10 and 5:4 in Portuguese; Literal gives the age with a bracketed "tinha" (m4), as 2 Samuel 5:4 does. "Roboão" and "Naamá, a amonita" take their usual Brazilian forms.

decisions.choice: "Xም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የN ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም N ዓመት ነገሠ" (Literal); "የእናቱም ስም ... ነበረ" at every level
decisions.reason: The opening formula for a king of Judah as the terms list sets it; Balanced and Readable follow their English levels. "ናዕማ" as Genesis 4:22; "አሞናዊቷ" from "አሞናውያን".

decisions.choice: "जब वह राजा बना तब N वर्ष का था, और उसने यरूशलेम में N वर्ष राज्य किया; उसकी माता का नाम X था"
decisions.reason: The age-and-mother formula of the history-books note for the kings of Judah (meaning m1), here first used; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "Rehoboam" as subject, and the remark about the chosen city stands where Hindi can carry it.
Naamah as Genesis 4:22 in this translation, the same Hebrew name; the queen mother (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: "Ему было N лет, когда он воцарился, и N лет он царствовал в Иерусалиме; имя его матери — X" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The age-and-mother formula for a king of Judah, as the history terms note words it; Readable splits it into short sentences. The same in 15:2 and 15:10.

decisions.choice: "Наама аммонитянка"
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian form; the queen mother (m2).

decisions.choice: Opening formula for a king of Judah: "Xは王となったときN歳で、エルサレムでN年治めた。母の名はY" (L), "…エルサレムでN年間治めた" (B); "XはN歳で王になり、エルサレムでN年間治めました" (R)
decisions.reason: Kept the same for each king of Judah (15:2, 15:10, 22:42); B and R give every reign length as "N年間治めた/治めました", as 11:42; ben N shanah is given as an age at every level.

decisions.choice: Rehoboam "レハブアム", Naamah "ナアマ"
decisions.reason: Rehoboam as MAT 1:7; Naamah as GEN 4:22, the same Hebrew name.

decisions.choice: The age-and-mother formula of the terms note at L and B: «Йому було N років, коли він зацарював, і N років він царював у Єрусалимі; імʼя його матері — X»; R shortens it
decisions.reason: The terms note sets one wording for every king of Judah; the Hebrew "a son of N years" is the ordinary way to give age, so Literal need not keep it.

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוּדָ֛ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְקַנְא֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ מִכֹּל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבֹתָ֔ם בְּחַטֹּאתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And did Judah the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and they provoked him to jealousy more than all that did their fathers with their sins which they sinned.

en.L: And Judah did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they provoked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to jealousy more than all that their fathers had done, with their sins that they sinned.
en.B: Judah did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. By the sins they committed they stirred up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} jealousy more than all their ancestors had done.
en.R: The people of Judah did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. Their sins made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} more jealous and angry than anything their ancestors had done.

es.L: Y Judá hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} provocaron a celos más que todo lo que habían hecho sus padres, con los pecados que cometieron.
es.B: Judá hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Con los pecados que cometieron, despertaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} celos más que todo lo que habían hecho sus antepasados.
es.R: El pueblo de Judá hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba. Sus pecados {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hicieron sentir más celoso y enojado que todo lo que habían hecho sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et Juda fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}excitèrent à la jalousie plus que tout ce qu’avaient fait leurs pères, par leurs péchés qu’ils commirent.
fr.B: Juda fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Par les péchés qu’ils commirent, ils provoquèrent {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} jalousie plus que ne l’avaient jamais fait leurs ancêtres.
fr.R: Les gens de Juda ont fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais. Leurs péchés {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont rendu plus jaloux et plus en colère que tout ce qu’avaient fait leurs ancêtres.

sw.L: Yuda akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao wakamtia wivu kuliko yote waliyoyafanya baba zao, kwa dhambi zao walizotenda.
sw.B: Yuda alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa dhambi walizotenda walichochea wivu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kuliko yote waliyofanya babu zao.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda walifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya. Dhambi zao zilimfanya aone wivu na kukasirika kuliko yote waliyofanya babu zao.

vi.L: Giu-đa làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ chọc cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ghen hơn mọi điều tổ phụ họ đã làm, bởi các tội họ đã phạm.
vi.B: Giu-đa làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Bởi các tội họ phạm, họ khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi cơn ghen hơn mọi điều tổ tiên họ đã làm.
vi.R: Dân Giu-đa làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Tội lỗi của họ khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ghen và giận hơn mọi điều tổ tiên họ đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 유다가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다. 그들은 자기들이 지은 죄로, 그들의 조상들이 한 모든 것보다 더 그분을 질투하시게 했다.
ko.B: 유다는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다. 그들은 자기들이 지은 죄로 그들의 조상들이 한 모든 일보다 더 그분의 질투를 불러일으켰다.
ko.R: 유다 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그들의 죄는 그들의 조상들이 한 어떤 일보다 더 그분을 질투하시고 노하시게 했다.

pt.L: E Judá fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} provocaram a ciúmes mais do que tudo o que os seus pais tinham feito, com os seus pecados que cometeram.
pt.B: Judá fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Com os pecados que cometeram, despertaram o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} zelo mais do que todos os seus antepassados tinham feito.
pt.R: O povo de Judá fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau. Os pecados deles deixaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} mais enciumado e irado do que tudo o que os seus antepassados tinham feito.

am.L: ይሁዳም {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ዓይን ክፉ የሆነውን አደረገ፤ አባቶቻቸውም ካደረጉት ሁሉ ይልቅ በሠሩት ኃጢአታቸው አስቀኑት።
am.B: ይሁዳ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ክፉ የሆነውን አደረገ። በሠሩትም ኃጢአት አባቶቻቸው ካደረጉት ሁሉ የበለጠ አስቀኑት።
am.R: የይሁዳ ሰዎች {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ክፉ ነው የሚለውን አደረጉ። ኃጢአታቸው አባቶቻቸው ካደረጉት ሁሉ የበለጠ አስቀናው፤ አስቆጣውም።

hi.L: और यहूदा ने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में बुरा था, और अपने किए हुए पापों से उन्होंने उन्हें उससे भी अधिक जलन दिलाई जितनी उनके पूर्वजों ने दिलाई थी।
hi.B: यहूदा ने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में बुरा था। अपने किए हुए पापों से उन्होंने उनमें इतनी जलन जगाई जितनी उनके पूर्वजों ने कभी नहीं जगाई थी।
hi.R: यहूदा के लोगों ने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में बुरा था। उनके पापों ने उनके पूर्वजों के सब कामों से बढ़कर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को जलन और क्रोध दिलाया।

ru.L: И Иуда делал то, что было злом в глазах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и они возбудили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ревность больше всего, что сделали их отцы, своими грехами, которыми они согрешили.
ru.B: Иуда делал то, что было злом в глазах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Своими грехами они возбудили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ревность больше, чем все их отцы.
ru.R: Народ Иуды делал то, что не нравилось {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Своими грехами они вызвали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ревность и гнев больше, чем всё, что делали их предки.

ja.L: そしてユダは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に悪であることを行い、彼らが犯した罪によって、彼らの先祖たちが行ったすべてのこと以上に、ねたみを起こさせた。
ja.B: ユダは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に悪とされることを行った。彼らは自分たちの犯した罪によって、先祖が行ったどんなことにもまして、主のねたみを引き起こした。
ja.R: ユダの人々は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が悪いと言われることをしました。その罪は、先祖たちがしたどんなことよりも、主をねたませ、怒らせました。

uk.L: І робив Юда зле в очах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і вони довели {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до ревнощів більше, ніж усе, що зробили їхні батьки, своїми гріхами, якими вони згрішили.
uk.B: Юда робив те, що було зле в очах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Гріхами, які вони вчинили, вони розпалили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ревнощі більше, ніж усе, що зробили їхні предки.
uk.R: Народ Юди робив те, що не подобалося {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}. Їхні гріхи розпалили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ревнощі й гнів більше, ніж усе, що зробили їхні предки.

decisions.choice: Judah did the evil: the people, as the Hebrew text reads
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "Rehoboam did the evil", which matches the usual verdict on a king. The Hebrew blames the people of Judah as a whole, and the plural verbs that follow ("they provoked") agree with it. The account of the reign in 2 Chronicles 12:1, 14 speaks of both the king and the people. The Hebrew reading is followed.

decisions.choice: provoked him to jealousy: Yahweh's demand for undivided loyalty
decisions.reason: Yahweh's jealousy is the rightful claim of a husband or covenant partner who will not share his people with other gods (Exodus 20:5; 34:14; Deuteronomy 32:16, 21). Worship of other gods stirs it up.

decisions.choice: the verdict: did evil in the sight of Yahweh
decisions.reason: Each reign in Kings is judged by this measure: did the king and people do what was right in Yahweh's sight, or what was evil? Judges uses the same words for Israel's turning away (Judges 2:11; 3:7).

decisions.choice: did what was evil in the sight of the LORD (Balanced); did what the LORD said was evil (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this verdict throughout the historical books.

decisions.choice: more jealous and angry (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable adds "angry" so that "jealous" is not heard as petty envy (m2).

decisions.choice: "hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que el SEÑOR reprueba" (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula as the Kings and Chronicles note sets for Spanish; recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "fit ce qui est mal aux yeux du SEIGNEUR" (L, B); "a fait ce que le SEIGNEUR déclare mauvais" (R)
alternatives: "fit le mal aux yeux du SEIGNEUR"
decisions.reason: The verdict as the Kings and Chronicles terms note words it, one wording per level for every reign.

decisions.choice: alifanya maovu machoni pa BWANA (Literal, Balanced); alifanya yale BWANA aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verdict on a reign has one wording per level through these books, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "làm điều ác trước mắt CHÚA" (L); "trước mặt CHÚA" (B); "làm điều CHÚA cho là ác" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's verdict formula at each level, used for every king and people in Kings.

decisions.choice: "주의 눈에 악한 일을 했다" (L), "주 보시기에 악한 일을 했다" (B), "주께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's verdict formula, held for every king in the block.

decisions.choice: fez o mal aos olhos do SENHOR (L); fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR (B); fez o que o SENHOR considerava mau (R)
alternatives: fez o que desagrada ao SENHOR
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the verdict on each reign (m3) keeps the wording of Judges 2:11 in Portuguese at each level, and its opposite is "fez o reto" (L), "fez o que era reto aos olhos do SENHOR" (B), "fez o que o SENHOR considerava certo" (R).

decisions.choice: o seu zelo (B); o SENHOR ... enciumado e irado (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "zelo", the Portuguese word for God's jealous claim on his people (m2), which "ciúme" can make sound petty; Literal keeps "provocar a ciúmes". Readable names the LORD instead of the pronoun, so its deity_pronoun span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ዓይን ክፉ የሆነውን አደረገ" (Literal); "... ፊት ክፉ የሆነውን አደረገ" (Balanced); "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ክፉ ነው የሚለውን አደረገ" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula as the terms list for Kings and the Amharic Judges set it; the same wording for every king in these chapters. "አስቀኑት" (provoked to jealousy) keeps the word of "a jealous God" (Exodus 20:5).

decisions.choice: "उसने वह किया जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दृष्टि में बुरा था" (here with Judah as subject)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula of the history-books note word for word, at Readable too, where the English varies it.

decisions.choice: "जलन दिलाई" (L); "जलन जगाई" (B); "जलन और क्रोध दिलाया" (R)
decisions.reason: Yahweh's demand for undivided loyalty (meaning m2), with the words of Deuteronomy 32:21 in this translation.

decisions.choice: the verdict formula
decisions.reason: As 11:6: "делал то, что было злом в глазах ГОСПОДА" (L, B), "что не нравилось ГОСПОДУ" (R).

decisions.choice: "ревность"
decisions.reason: The LORD's demand for undivided loyalty (m2), as the Pentateuch drafts render the jealous God.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の目に悪であることを行う" (L), "…の目に悪とされることを行う" (B), "…が悪いと言われることをする" (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict on a reign, as JDG 2:11, kept through Kings.

decisions.choice: qinne' "ねたみを起こさせる" (L), "ねたみを引き起こす" (B), "ねたませ、怒らせる" (R)
decisions.reason: God's jealousy for his people's loyalty, as qanna (EXO 34:14) is ねたむ; Readable adds anger, as the English Readable does. Balanced and Readable name 主 for the English pronoun.

source.text: וַיִּבְנ֨וּ גַם־הֵ֧מָּה לָהֶ֛ם בָּמ֥וֹת וּמַצֵּב֖וֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִ֑ים עַ֚ל כָּל־גִּבְעָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And built also they for themselves high places and standing stones and Asherah poles on every hill high and under every tree luxuriant.

en.L: And they also built for themselves high places and standing stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every leafy tree.
en.B: They also built for themselves high places, standing stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every leafy tree.
en.R: They built hilltop shrines for themselves. They set up stone pillars and poles used to worship Asherah on every high hill and under every large, leafy tree.

es.L: Y también ellos se edificaron lugares altos, y estelas, y postes de Aserá sobre toda colina alta y debajo de todo árbol frondoso.
es.B: También se edificaron lugares altos, piedras sagradas y postes de Aserá sobre toda colina alta y debajo de todo árbol frondoso.
es.R: Se construyeron santuarios sobre las colinas. Levantaron piedras para adorar a los dioses y postes que usaban para adorar a Aserá sobre toda colina alta y debajo de todo árbol grande y frondoso.

fr.L: Et eux aussi se bâtirent des hauts lieux, des stèles et des poteaux d’Ashéra, sur toute colline élevée et sous tout arbre verdoyant.
fr.B: Ils se bâtirent eux aussi des hauts lieux, des pierres dressées et des poteaux d’Ashéra sur toute colline élevée et sous tout arbre verdoyant.
fr.R: Ils se sont construit des sanctuaires sur les collines. Ils ont dressé des pierres sacrées et des poteaux pour adorer la déesse Ashéra sur toutes les hautes collines et sous tous les grands arbres feuillus.

sw.L: Wao nao wakajijengea mahali pa juu, na nguzo za mawe, na miti ya Ashera juu ya kila kilima kirefu na chini ya kila mti wenye majani mengi.
sw.B: Wao pia wakajijengea mahali pa juu, nguzo za mawe na miti ya Ashera juu ya kila kilima kirefu na chini ya kila mti wenye majani mengi.
sw.R: Wakajijengea patakatifu pa kilimani. Wakasimamisha nguzo za mawe na nguzo za kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera juu ya kila kilima kirefu na chini ya kila mti mkubwa wenye majani mengi.

vi.L: Họ cũng xây cho mình các nơi cao, các trụ đá và các trụ A-sê-ra trên mọi đồi cao và dưới mọi cây xanh rậm lá.
vi.B: Họ cũng xây cho mình các nơi cao, dựng các trụ đá và các trụ A-sê-ra trên mọi đồi cao và dưới mọi cây xanh rậm lá.
vi.R: Họ xây cho mình những nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao. Họ dựng các trụ đá và các trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra trên mọi ngọn đồi cao và dưới mọi cây to rậm lá.

ko.L: 그리고 그들도 모든 높은 언덕 위와 모든 무성한 나무 아래에 자기들을 위해 산당과 돌기둥과 아세라 목상들을 세웠다.
ko.B: 그들도 모든 높은 언덕 위와 모든 푸른 나무 아래에 산당과 돌기둥과 아세라 목상들을 세웠다.
ko.R: 그들은 자기들을 위해 산꼭대기 제단들을 쌓았다. 또 모든 높은 언덕 위와 잎이 무성한 큰 나무 아래마다 돌기둥과 아세라 여신을 섬기는 목상들을 세웠다.

pt.L: E também eles edificaram para si altos, e colunas, e postes de Aserá sobre toda colina alta e debaixo de toda árvore verdejante.
pt.B: Eles também construíram para si altos, colunas sagradas e postes de Aserá em toda colina alta e debaixo de toda árvore frondosa.
pt.R: Eles construíram para si santuários no alto dos morros. Levantaram colunas de pedra usadas no culto e postes usados para adorar a deusa Aserá em toda colina alta e debaixo de toda árvore grande e frondosa.

am.L: እነርሱም ደግሞ በረጅሙ ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ፣ ከለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች የኮረብታ መስገጃዎችን፣ ሐውልቶችንና አሼራዎችን ለራሳቸው ሠሩ።
am.B: እነርሱም ደግሞ በረጅሙ ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይና ቅጠሉ በለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ ሥር የኮረብታ መስገጃዎችን፣ የማምለኪያ ሐውልቶችንና የአሼራ ማምለኪያ እንጨቶችን ለራሳቸው ሠሩ።
am.R: ለራሳቸውም የኮረብታ መስገጃዎችን ሠሩ። በረጅሙ ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይና በለመለመው ትልቅ ዛፍ ሁሉ ሥር የድንጋይ ሐውልቶችንና አሼራን ለማምለክ የሚጠቀሙባቸውን የእንጨት ዘንጎች አቆሙ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने भी अपने लिए हर ऊँची पहाड़ी पर और हर हरे वृक्ष के नीचे ऊँचे स्थान, और पूजा के पत्थर, और अशेरा के खंभे बनाए।
hi.B: उन्होंने भी हर ऊँची पहाड़ी पर और हर घने वृक्ष के नीचे अपने लिए ऊँचे स्थान, पूजा के पत्थर और अशेरा के खंभे बनाए।
hi.R: उन्होंने अपने लिए ऊँचे स्थान बनाए। हर ऊँची पहाड़ी पर और हर बड़े घने पेड़ के नीचे उन्होंने पूजा के लिए पत्थर के स्तंभ और अशेरा देवी के खंभे खड़े किए।

ru.L: И построили и они себе высоты, и священные столбы, и столбы Ашеры на всяком высоком холме и под всяким ветвистым деревом.
ru.B: Они тоже построили себе святилища на холмах, поставили священные столбы и столбы Ашеры на каждом высоком холме и под каждым ветвистым деревом.
ru.R: Они построили себе святилища на холмах. Они поставили каменные столбы и деревянные столбы для поклонения богине Ашере на каждом высоком холме и под каждым большим ветвистым деревом.

ja.L: 彼らもまた、すべての高い丘の上と、すべての茂った木の下に、自分たちのために高き所と柱とアシェラ像を築いた。
ja.B: 彼らもまた、高い丘の上や茂った木の下のいたるところに、自分たちのために高き所と石の柱とアシェラ像を築いた。
ja.R: ユダの人々も、自分たちのために丘の上の礼拝所を造りました。そして、高い丘の上や、葉の茂った大きな木の下のどこにでも、石の柱や、女神アシェラを拝むための木の柱を立てました。

uk.L: І збудували вони й собі пагірки, і священні камені, і ашери на кожному високому пагорбі і під кожним зеленим деревом.
uk.B: Вони теж збудували собі узвишшя, священні камені й стовпи Ашери на кожному високому пагорбі й під кожним розлогим деревом.
uk.R: Вони збудували собі святилища на узвишшях. Вони поставили камʼяні стовпи і стовпи для поклоніння Ашері на кожному високому пагорбі і під кожним великим розлогим деревом.

decisions.choice: high places, standing stones and Asherah poles: places and objects of worship
decisions.reason: High places were local shrines with altars, often on hills (3:2). Standing stones were upright stones set up as sacred markers, which the law ordered Israel to break down when they were used in Canaanite worship (Exodus 23:24; Deuteronomy 16:22). Asherah poles: see verse 15.

decisions.choice: on every high hill and under every leafy tree: the places where the nations worshiped
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 12:2 commands Israel to destroy the places where the nations served their gods "on the high mountains and on the hills and under every leafy tree". Judah now builds such places for itself. The phrase is used again of this worship (2 Kings 16:4; 17:10).

decisions.choice: they also: Judah as well as Israel
decisions.reason: Judah too, not only the northern kingdom of verses 15-16, turned to these forms of worship.

decisions.choice: hilltop shrines, stone pillars, poles used to worship Asherah (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in these books.

decisions.choice: "estelas" (L); "piedras sagradas" (B); "piedras para adorar a los dioses" (R)
decisions.reason: The standing stones as the Kings and Chronicles terms table sets for each level.

decisions.choice: "stèles" (L); "pierres dressées" (B); "pierres sacrées" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note: Literal "stèles", Balanced "pierres dressées"; Readable adds that they were sacred, as the English Readable explains.

decisions.choice: "các trụ đá" for the standing stones
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording at every level.

decisions.choice: "돌기둥" for the standing stones at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note's word: a plain description of an upright stone, where "석상" would suggest a carved statue.

decisions.choice: colunas (L), colunas sagradas (B), colunas de pedra usadas no culto (R); árvore verdejante (L), frondosa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The standing stones and the place of foreign worship (m1, m2) take the words of Deuteronomy 12:2-3 and 16:22 in Portuguese, level by level, so that the echo of Deuteronomy 12:2 is kept.

decisions.choice: "ሐውልቶች" (Literal), "የማምለኪያ ሐውልቶች" (Balanced), "የድንጋይ ሐውልቶች" (Readable); "ከለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች" as Deuteronomy 12:2
decisions.reason: Standing stones and the leafy trees keep the wording of the Amharic Exodus 34:13 and Deuteronomy 12:2.

decisions.choice: "ऊँचे स्थान"; "पूजा के पत्थर" (L, B), "पूजा के लिए पत्थर के स्तंभ" (R); "अशेरा के खंभे"
decisions.reason: The kingdom table of the history-books note at every level; the standing stones as Deuteronomy 16:22 Balanced in this translation.

decisions.choice: "हर हरे वृक्ष के नीचे" (L); "हर घने वृक्ष" (B); "हर बड़े घने पेड़" (R)
decisions.reason: The places where the nations worshiped (meaning m2), as Deuteronomy 12:2 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "высоты, священные столбы, столбы Ашеры" (L); "святилища на холмах, священные столбы, столбы Ашеры" (B); "святилища на холмах, каменные столбы, деревянные столбы для поклонения богине Ашере" (R)
decisions.reason: The history terms note's table, with standing stones worded as Deuteronomy 12:3 in Russian.

decisions.choice: "под всяким ветвистым деревом"
decisions.reason: The phrase of Deuteronomy 12:2 in Russian ("ветвистым" at Balanced there).

decisions.choice: bamot "高き所" (L, B), "丘の上の礼拝所" (R); matstsevot "柱" (L), "石の柱" (B, R); asherim "アシェラ像" (L, B), "女神アシェラを拝むための木の柱" (R)
decisions.reason: As NUM 33:52, 1SA 9 and 1KI 3:2; EXO 23-24 and DEU 7:5 for the pillars and the Asherah poles. Kept for the whole chunk.

source.text: וְגַם־קָדֵ֖שׁ הָיָ֣ה בָאָ֑רֶץ עָשׂ֗וּ כְּכֹל֙ הַתּוֹעֲבֹ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And also male cult prostitute was in the land; they did according to all the abominations of the nations which dispossessed Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And there were also male cult prostitutes in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land. The people did all the detestable things of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: There were even men in the land who served as prostitutes at the shrines. The people did all the disgusting things that the nations had done before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} drove them out of the land for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Y también había prostitutos de culto en la tierra. Hicieron conforme a todas las abominaciones de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Hubo incluso prostitutos de los santuarios en la tierra. El pueblo hizo todas las prácticas detestables de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado delante de los israelitas.
es.R: Hasta había en el país hombres que servían como prostitutos en los santuarios. El pueblo hizo todas las cosas repugnantes que habían hecho las naciones antes de que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} las expulsara de la tierra para dársela a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et il y eut aussi des prostitués sacrés dans le pays. Ils firent selon toutes les abominations des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassées devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Il y eut même dans le pays des hommes qui se prostituaient dans les sanctuaires. Le peuple commit toutes les pratiques odieuses des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassées devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Il y avait même dans le pays des hommes qui servaient de prostitués dans les sanctuaires. Le peuple a fait toutes les choses horribles que faisaient les nations avant que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les chasse du pays pour le donner aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Tena kulikuwa na makahaba wa kiume wa ibada katika nchi. Wakafanya sawasawa na machukizo yote ya mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Hata kulikuwa na makahaba wa kiume wa mahali pa ibada katika nchi. Watu walifanya machukizo yote ya mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Hata kulikuwa na wanaume katika nchi waliofanya ukahaba katika mahali pa ibada. Watu walifanya mambo yote ya kuchukiza yaliyofanywa na mataifa kabla {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hajayafukuza kutoka katika nchi kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.

vi.L: Trong xứ cũng có nam kỹ nơi miếu thờ. Họ làm theo mọi điều ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi khỏi trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Trong xứ thậm chí còn có nam kỹ nơi miếu thờ. Dân chúng làm mọi điều ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi đi trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Trong xứ thậm chí còn có những người đàn ông làm nghề mại dâm tại các nơi thờ thần. Dân chúng làm mọi điều đáng ghê tởm mà các dân tộc kia đã làm trước khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đuổi họ ra khỏi xứ để ban xứ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그 땅에는 신전 남창도 있었다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 모든 가증한 일을 따라 행했다.
ko.B: 그 땅에는 신전 남창까지 있었다. 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들이 하던 역겨운 일을 모두 그대로 따라 했다.
ko.R: 그 땅에는 신전에서 몸을 파는 남자들까지 있었다. 백성은 이방 민족들이 하던 역겨운 일을 모두 따라 했다. 그 민족들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손을 위해 그 땅에서 쫓아내신 민족들이었다.

pt.L: E também havia prostitutos cultuais na terra. Fizeram conforme todas as abominações das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Havia até prostitutos de santuário na terra. O povo praticou todas as coisas abomináveis das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos israelitas.
pt.R: Havia até homens na terra que se prostituíam nos santuários. O povo fez todas as coisas abomináveis que as nações faziam antes que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} as expulsasse da terra para dar lugar aos israelitas.

am.L: በምድሪቱም ደግሞ የቤተ ጣዖት ወንድ ዝሙት አዳሪዎች ነበሩ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳስወጣቸው እንደ ሕዝቦቹ አስጸያፊ ሥራ ሁሉ አደረጉ።
am.B: በምድሪቱም የቤተ ጣዖት ወንድ ዝሙት አዳሪዎች እንኳ ነበሩ። ሕዝቡም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ያስወጣቸውን ሕዝቦች አስጸያፊ ሥራ ሁሉ አደረጉ።
am.R: በምድሪቱም በጣዖት ማምለኪያ ስፍራዎች በዝሙት አዳሪነት የሚሠሩ ወንዶች እንኳ ነበሩ። ሕዝቡ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከፊታቸው አስወጥቶ ምድሪቱን ለእስራኤላውያን ከመስጠቱ በፊት በዚያ የነበሩት ሕዝቦች ያደርጉት የነበረውን አስጸያፊ ነገር ሁሉ አደረጉ።

hi.L: और देश में देवदास भी थे। उन्होंने उन जातियों के सब घृणित कामों के अनुसार किया जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} के सामने से निकाल दिया था।
hi.B: देश में पूजा-स्थलों के पुरुष वेश्या भी थे। लोगों ने उन जातियों के सब घृणित काम किए जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने इस्राएलियों के आगे से निकाल दिया था।
hi.R: देश में ऐसे पुरुष भी थे जो पूजा-स्थलों पर वेश्या का काम करते थे। लोग वही सब घिनौने काम करने लगे जो वे जातियाँ करती थीं जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने इस्राएलियों के लिए देश से निकाल दिया था।

ru.L: И были также храмовые блудники в земле. Они поступали по всем мерзостям народов, которых {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} изгнал от лица {{gender:детей Израиля|сынов Израиля}}.
ru.B: В стране были даже храмовые блудники. Народ поступал по всем мерзостям народов, которых {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} изгнал перед израильтянами.
ru.R: В стране были даже мужчины, которые занимались блудом при святилищах. Люди делали все те отвратительные дела, которые делали народы, прежде чем {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} изгнал их из этой земли ради израильтян.

ja.L: また、その地には神殿男娼もいた。彼らは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がイスラエルの子らの前から追い払われた諸国の民の、すべての忌むべきことのとおりに行った。
ja.B: その地には神殿男娼さえいた。民は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がイスラエルの人々の前から追い払われた諸国の民の、あらゆる忌むべきことを行った。
ja.R: その地には、礼拝所で体を売る男たちまでいました。人々は、昔この土地に住んでいた国々の民がしていた、ひどく汚らわしいことを、すべて行いました。その民は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がイスラエルの人々のために追い出された民でした。

uk.L: І були також у краю храмові розпусники. Вони чинили за всіма гидотами народів, яких {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вигнав перед {{gender:нащадками Ізраїля|синами Ізраїля}}.
uk.B: У краю були навіть храмові розпусники. Народ чинив усі гидоти народів, яких {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вигнав перед ізраїльтянами.
uk.R: У краю навіть були чоловіки, які віддавалися розпусті при святилищах. Люди робили всі ті гидкі речі, які робили народи, перш ніж {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} вигнав їх із краю заради ізраїльтян.

decisions.choice: male cult prostitutes: men attached to the shrines, probably for sexual rites
decisions.reason: The word (qadesh) means "consecrated one", a man set apart for a shrine. The law forbids it alongside the female form, which is used for a prostitute (Deuteronomy 23:18-19; Genesis 38:21-22). It is usually taken to mean men who served as prostitutes in the worship of other gods. Some think the word means men who served at the shrines in other ways, and that a sexual role is less certain. The singular here stands for a whole class of people. Later kings of Judah remove them (15:12; 22:47; 2 Kings 23:7).

decisions.choice: abominations: practices Yahweh detests
decisions.reason: The word is used for what is utterly offensive to Yahweh, especially the worship and customs of the Canaanite nations (Deuteronomy 18:9-12; 20:18).

decisions.choice: the nations Yahweh drove out before Israel: Judah repeats the sins for which the land was taken from them
decisions.reason: The nations lost the land because of these practices (Leviticus 18:24-28; Deuteronomy 9:4-5). If Judah does the same, it faces the same end.

decisions.choice: male cult prostitutes (Literal); male shrine prostitutes (Balanced); men who served as prostitutes at the shrines (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 23:18, and the same at 15:12 and 22:47. Literal adds the plural, since the singular stands for a group (m1).

decisions.choice: abominations (Literal); detestable things (Balanced); disgusting things (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use words more common today for things that are deeply offensive.

decisions.choice: "prostitutos de culto" (L); "prostitutos de los santuarios" (B); "hombres que servían como prostitutos en los santuarios" (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish names the men's role directly, as the English does at each level; the masculine "prostitutos" keeps the Hebrew's male form.

decisions.choice: "prostitués sacrés" (L); "hommes qui se prostituaient dans les sanctuaires" (B, R)
decisions.reason: French has a masculine noun for the male cult prostitute; Balanced and Readable describe the men as the English does. The same at 15:12 and 22:47.

decisions.choice: "nam kỹ nơi miếu thờ" (L, B)
decisions.reason: A short term for the men attached to the shrines; Readable says it in plain words.

decisions.choice: "가증한 일" (L), "역겨운 일" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional word for what the LORD detests; Balanced and Readable use the everyday word, as the English moves from "abominations" to "detestable" and "disgusting".

decisions.choice: prostitutos cultuais (L); prostitutos de santuário (B); homens ... que se prostituíam nos santuários (R); abominações (L), abomináveis (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (15:12; 22:47): the men attached to the shrines (m1) take the words of Deuteronomy 23:18 in Portuguese, "prostituto cultual" at Literal and "prostituto de santuário" at Balanced, and Readable says what they did, as the English levels do. "Abominação" (L) and "abominável" (B, R) follow Deuteronomy (m2).

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms set it: "filhos" already includes daughters and "israelitas" names the people, so Portuguese has no second wording for the English gender setting to offer.

decisions.choice: "የቤተ ጣዖት ወንድ ዝሙት አዳሪዎች" (Literal, Balanced); Readable as the Readable of Deuteronomy 23:18
decisions.reason: The qadesh keeps the wording of the Amharic Deuteronomy 23:18; "አስጸያፊ" (detestable) for the abominations, as the Pentateuch settled. No gender span for "the sons of Israel".

decisions.choice: "देवदास" (L); "पूजा-स्थलों के पुरुष वेश्या" (B); R explains
decisions.reason: Men attached to the shrines, probably for sexual rites (meaning m1), with the words of Deuteronomy 23:18 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}}" (L); "इस्राएलियों" (B, R), no span
"храмовые блудники" (L, B); "мужчины, которые занимались блудом при святилищах" (R)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 23:18 in Russian.

decisions.choice: "мерзости" (L, B); "отвратительные дела" (R)
decisions.reason: Practices the LORD detests (m2); "мерзость" as Deuteronomy in Russian.

decisions.choice: qadesh "神殿男娼" (L, B), "礼拝所で体を売る男たち" (R)
decisions.reason: The male counterpart of qedeshah (GEN 38:21 神殿娼婦); the exact role is uncertain, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: to'evot "忌むべきこと" (L, B), "ひどく汚らわしいこと" (R)
decisions.reason: As DEU and LEV.

source.text: וַיְהִ֛י בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֖ית לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֑ם עָלָ֛ה שִׁישַׁ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in the year the fifth of King Rehoboam, came up Shishak king of Egypt against Jerusalem.

en.L: And it happened in the fifth year of King Rehoboam [that] Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.
en.B: In King Rehoboam's fifth year, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.
en.R: In the fifth year that Rehoboam was king, Shishak, the king of Egypt, attacked Jerusalem.

es.L: Y sucedió en el año quinto del rey Roboam [que] Sisac, rey de Egipto, subió contra Jerusalén.
es.B: En el quinto año del rey Roboam, Sisac, rey de Egipto, subió contra Jerusalén.
es.R: En el quinto año del reinado de Roboam, Sisac, el rey de Egipto, atacó Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et il arriva, la cinquième année du roi Roboam, [que] Shishaq, roi d’Égypte, monta contre Jérusalem.
fr.B: La cinquième année du règne de Roboam, Shishaq, roi d’Égypte, monta contre Jérusalem.
fr.R: Pendant la cinquième année du règne de Roboam, Shishaq, le roi d’Égypte, a attaqué Jérusalem.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa tano wa mfalme Rehoboamu, Shishaki mfalme wa Misri akapanda dhidi ya Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa tano wa mfalme Rehoboamu, Shishaki mfalme wa Misri alipanda kuushambulia Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa tano wa utawala wa Rehoboamu, Shishaki, mfalme wa Misri, aliushambulia Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào năm thứ năm đời vua Rô-bô-am, Si-sắc vua Ai Cập đi lên đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Năm thứ năm đời vua Rô-bô-am, Si-sắc vua Ai Cập đi lên đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Vào năm thứ năm Rô-bô-am làm vua, Si-sắc, vua Ai Cập, tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암 왕 제5년에 이집트 왕 시삭이 예루살렘을 치러 올라왔다.
ko.B: 르호보암 왕이 다스린 지 5년째 되는 해에 이집트 왕 시삭이 예루살렘을 치러 올라왔다.
ko.R: 르호보암이 왕이 된 지 5년째 되는 해에 이집트 왕 시삭이 예루살렘을 공격했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu no quinto ano do rei Roboão [que] Sisaque, rei do Egito, subiu contra Jerusalém.
pt.B: No quinto ano do rei Roboão, Sisaque, rei do Egito, subiu contra Jerusalém.
pt.R: No quinto ano em que Roboão era rei, Sisaque, o rei do Egito, atacou Jerusalém.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በንጉሡ በሮብዓም በአምስተኛው ዓመት የግብፅ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ወጣ።
am.B: በንጉሡ በሮብዓም በአምስተኛው ዓመት የግብፅ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ወጣ።
am.R: ሮብዓም በነገሠ በአምስተኛው ዓመት የግብፅ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅ ኢየሩሳሌምን ወጋ።

hi.L: और राजा रहबाम के पाँचवें वर्ष में ऐसा हुआ कि मिस्र का राजा शीशक यरूशलेम पर चढ़ आया।
hi.B: राजा रहबाम के पाँचवें वर्ष में मिस्र का राजा शीशक यरूशलेम पर चढ़ आया।
hi.R: रहबाम के राज्य के पाँचवें वर्ष में मिस्र के राजा शीशक ने यरूशलेम पर हमला किया।

ru.L: И было в пятый год царя Ровоама, поднялся Шишак, царь Египта, на Иерусалим.
ru.B: На пятом году царствования Ровоама Шишак, царь Египта, выступил против Иерусалима.
ru.R: Когда Ровоам был царём пятый год, Шишак, царь Египта, напал на Иерусалим.

ja.L: そしてレハブアム王の第五年に、エジプトの王シシャクがエルサレムに攻め上って来た。
ja.B: レハブアム王の治世の第五年に、エジプトの王シシャクがエルサレムに攻め上って来た。
ja.R: レハブアムが王になって五年目に、エジプトの王シシャクがエルサレムを攻めて来ました。

uk.L: І сталося пʼятого року царя Ровоама, [що] піднявся Шишак, цар Єгипту, на Єрусалим.
uk.B: Пʼятого року царя Ровоама Шишак, цар Єгипту, піднявся на Єрусалим.
uk.R: На пʼятий рік Ровоамового царювання Шишак, цар Єгипту, напав на Єрусалим.

decisions.choice: Shishak king of Egypt: the pharaoh Sheshonq I
decisions.reason: Shishak is the Egyptian king Sheshonq I, who founded a new line of kings. He had given Jeroboam shelter when he fled from Solomon (11:40). His own inscription at the temple of Karnak in Egypt lists many towns in Judah and Israel that his army attacked, a campaign usually dated about 925 BC. 2 Chronicles 12:2-12 tells this attack more fully.

decisions.choice: Shishak: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) spell the name slightly differently; the form marked to be read aloud (qere) is Shishak, as in 11:40. The person is the same.

decisions.choice: in the fifth year of King Rehoboam: the attack follows Judah's sins
decisions.reason: The story places the invasion straight after the account of Judah's sins (verses 22-24). 2 Chronicles 12:2, 5 says it plainly: Shishak came because the people had been unfaithful to Yahweh.

decisions.choice: attacked Jerusalem (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Came up against" means came to attack; Jerusalem lies in the hills, so an army from Egypt "came up" to it.

decisions.choice: "Sisac"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's form; the Hebrew says "king of Egypt" here, so "faraón" is not added.

decisions.choice: Sisaque, rei do Egito
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 11:40): the pharaoh (m1) takes the Brazilian form "Sisaque", with the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant.

decisions.choice: "ሺሻቅ" (Shishak)
decisions.reason: As the terms list names him.

decisions.choice: Shishak "シシャク"
decisions.reason: The form read aloud (qere), as the English.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־אֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶת־אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאֶת־הַכֹּ֖ל לָקָ֑ח וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־כָּל־מָגִנֵּ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he took [the] treasures of [the] house of Yahweh and [the] treasures of [the] house of the king, and the all he took; and he took all [the] shields of the gold which made Solomon.

en.L: And he took the treasures of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the treasures of the house of the king; he took everything. And he took all the shields of gold that Solomon had made.
en.B: He carried off the treasures of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and those of the king's palace. He took everything, even all the gold shields Solomon had made.
en.R: He carried off the treasures from the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and from the king's palace. He took everything. He even took all the gold shields that Solomon had made.

es.L: Y tomó los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los tesoros de la casa del rey; lo tomó todo. Y tomó todos los escudos de oro que Salomón había hecho.
es.B: Se llevó los tesoros de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los del palacio real. Se lo llevó todo, incluso todos los escudos de oro que Salomón había hecho.
es.R: Se llevó los tesoros del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y del palacio del rey. Se lo llevó todo. Hasta se llevó todos los escudos de oro que Salomón había hecho.

fr.L: Et il prit les trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les trésors de la maison du roi ; il prit tout. Et il prit tous les boucliers d’or que Salomon avait faits.
fr.B: Il emporta les trésors de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et ceux du palais royal. Il prit tout, même tous les boucliers d’or que Salomon avait faits.
fr.R: Il a emporté les trésors du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et ceux du palais du roi. Il a tout pris. Il a même pris tous les boucliers d’or que Salomon avait faits.

sw.L: Akachukua hazina za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na hazina za nyumba ya mfalme; akachukua kila kitu. Akachukua pia ngao zote za dhahabu alizozitengeneza Sulemani.
sw.B: Alichukua hazina za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na za ikulu ya mfalme. Alichukua kila kitu, hata ngao zote za dhahabu alizotengeneza Sulemani.
sw.R: Alichukua hazina za hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na za ikulu ya mfalme. Alichukua kila kitu. Hata alichukua ngao zote za dhahabu ambazo Sulemani alikuwa amezitengeneza.

vi.L: Ông lấy các kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các kho báu của nhà vua; ông lấy tất cả. Ông cũng lấy tất cả các khiên bằng vàng mà Sa-lô-môn đã làm.
vi.B: Vua ấy lấy đi các kho báu của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và của cung vua. Vua lấy hết mọi thứ, kể cả tất cả các khiên vàng Sa-lô-môn đã làm.
vi.R: Vua ấy lấy đi các kho báu trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong cung vua. Vua lấy hết mọi thứ. Vua còn lấy tất cả các khiên vàng mà Sa-lô-môn đã làm.
